SELECT m.model_id, m.name AS model_name, m.algorithm, m.description, GROUP_CONCAT(h.name || ': ' || h.value, '; ') AS hyperparameters, mp.cv_score, mp.holdout_score, mp.holdout_roc_auc_score, mp.training_time, mp.evaluation_time, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mp.holdout_roc_auc_score DESC) AS model_rank, GROUP_CONCAT(d.name, ', ') AS associated_datasets FROM models m JOIN model_performance mp ON m.model_id = mp.model_id LEFT JOIN hyperparameters h ON m.model_id = h.model_id LEFT JOIN model_dataset md ON m.model_id = md.model_id LEFT JOIN datasets d ON md.dataset_id = d.dataset_id WHERE m.algorithm = 'XGBoost' AND mp.holdout_roc_auc_score > 0.7 GROUP BY m.model_id, m.name, m.algorithm, m.description, mp.cv_score, mp.holdout_score, mp.holdout_roc_auc_score, mp.training_time, mp.evaluation_time ORDER BY mp.holdout_roc_auc_score DESC

WITH DelaysInJan2022 AS (
    SELECT 
        f.airport_id,
        f.carrier_id,
        COUNT(fd.flight_delay_id) AS delay_count
    FROM flights f
    INNER JOIN flight_delays fd ON f.flight_id = fd.flight_id
    WHERE f.departure_date LIKE '2022-01-%'
    GROUP BY f.airport_id, f.carrier_id
),
RankedDelays AS (
    SELECT 
        d.airport_id,
        d.carrier_id,
        d.delay_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.airport_id ORDER BY d.delay_count DESC) AS rank
    FROM DelaysInJan2022 d
)
SELECT 
    a.name AS airport_name,
    c.name AS carrier_name,
    rd.delay_count
FROM RankedDelays rd
INNER JOIN airports a ON rd.airport_id = a.airport_id
INNER JOIN carriers c ON rd.carrier_id = c.carrier_id
WHERE rd.rank <= 3
ORDER BY a.name, rd.rank;

SELECT s.suburb_name, (COALESCE(e.median_weekly_income, 0) + COALESCE(e.average_household_income, 0) + COALESCE(soc.life_satisfaction_score, 0) + COALESCE(soc.sentiment_score, 0) + COALESCE(soc.healthcare_quality_score, 0) - COALESCE(soc.crime_rate, 0) + COALESCE(dem.population, 0) - COALESCE(dem.unemployment_rate, 0) - COALESCE(dem.homeless_rate, 0) + COALESCE(dem.citizenship_percentage, 0)) AS overall_score FROM suburbs s LEFT JOIN economic_statistics e ON s.suburb_code = e.suburb_code LEFT JOIN social_statistics soc ON s.suburb_code = soc.suburb_code LEFT JOIN demographic_statistics dem ON s.suburb_code = dem.suburb_code ORDER BY overall_score DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH MaxTemps2023 AS (
    SELECT

        wo.temperature_unit,
        wo.observation_date,
        wo.obs_id
    FROM weather_observations wo
    WHERE strftime('%Y', wo.observation_date) = '2023'
      AND wo.temperature = (
          SELECT MAX(temperature) 
          FROM weather_observations 
          WHERE station_id = wo.station_id 
            AND strftime('%Y', observation_date) = '2023'
      )
),
UserAccessCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        al.obs_id,
        al.user_id,
        COUNT(*) AS access_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY al.obs_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM access_logs al
    GROUP BY al.obs_id, al.user_id
),
MostFrequentUsers AS (
    SELECT 
        uac.obs_id,
        u.user_name AS most_frequent_user
    FROM UserAccessCounts uac
    JOIN users u ON uac.user_id = u.user_id
    WHERE uac.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    ws.station_name,
    mt.max_temperature,
    mt.temperature_unit,
    mt.observation_date,
    mfu.most_frequent_user
FROM MaxTemps2023 mt
JOIN weather_stations ws ON mt.station_id = ws.station_id
LEFT JOIN MostFrequentUsers mfu ON mt.obs_id = mfu.obs_id
ORDER BY mt.max_temperature DESC;

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.machine_no ORDER BY ml.duration_per_event DESC) AS rank

    WHERE strftime('%Y', ml.start_down) = '2022'
)
SELECT

WITH carrier_airport_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.airport_id,
        a.name AS airport_name,
        c.carrier_id,
        c.name AS carrier_name,
        COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id), 0) AS total_flights,
        COALESCE(SUM(fs.cancelled), 0) AS cancellations,
        COALESCE(SUM(fs.delayed), 0) AS delays,
        COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN fd.delay_minutes IS NOT NULL THEN fd.delay_minutes END), 0) AS avg_delay_minutes
    FROM airports a
    LEFT JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.airport_id
    LEFT JOIN carriers c ON f.carrier_id = c.carrier_id
    LEFT JOIN flight_statistics fs ON a.airport_id = fs.airport_id AND f.carrier_id IS NOT NULL
    LEFT JOIN flight_delays fd ON f.flight_id = fd.flight_id
    GROUP BY a.airport_id, c.carrier_id
    HAVING total_flights > 0
),
ranked_carriers AS (
    SELECT 
        airport_id,
        airport_name,
        carrier_id,
        carrier_name,
        total_flights,
        cancellations,
        delays,
        avg_delay_minutes,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY airport_id ORDER BY (cancellations + delays) DESC) AS performance_rank
    FROM carrier_airport_stats
)
SELECT 
    airport_name,
    carrier_name,
    total_flights,
    cancellations,
    delays,
    avg_delay_minutes
FROM ranked_carriers
WHERE performance_rank <= 3
ORDER BY airport_name, performance_rank;

WITH RECURSIVE region_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        region_id,
        region_name,
        parent_region_id,
        region_name AS full_path
    FROM geographic_regions
    WHERE parent_region_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        gr.region_id,
        gr.region_name,
        gr.parent_region_id,
        rp.full_path || ' > ' || gr.region_name
    FROM geographic_regions gr
    INNER JOIN region_paths rp ON gr.parent_region_id = rp.region_id
),
region_dataset_access AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.region_id,
        rd.dataset_id,
        COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count
    FROM region_dataset rd
    INNER JOIN access_logs al ON rd.dataset_id = al.data_id
    GROUP BY rd.region_id, rd.dataset_id
    HAVING COUNT(al.access_id) >= 1
),
dataset_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        dataset_id,
        SUM(access_count) AS cumulative_access_count
    FROM region_dataset_access
    GROUP BY dataset_id
)
SELECT 
    rp.full_path AS region_full_path,
    d.dataset_name,
    d.description,
    d.source,
    rda.access_count,
    dc.cumulative_access_count
FROM region_dataset_access rda
INNER JOIN region_paths rp ON rda.region_id = rp.region_id
INNER JOIN datasets d ON rda.dataset_id = d.dataset_id
INNER JOIN dataset_cumulative dc ON rda.dataset_id = dc.dataset_id
ORDER BY 
    (SELECT MAX(access_date) FROM access_logs WHERE data_id = rda.dataset_id) DESC,
    rda.access_count DESC;

WITH ApprovedOvertime AS (

        SUM(s.shift_duration) AS total_approved_hours
    FROM overtime_requests o
    JOIN shifts s ON o.shift_id = s.shift_id
    JOIN employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id
    WHERE o.request_status = 'approved'
    GROUP BY e.department, strftime('%Y-%m', o.request_date)
),
MaxHoursPerDept AS (
    SELECT

        MAX(total_approved_hours) AS max_hours
    FROM ApprovedOvertime

)

    ao.month,
    ao.total_approved_hours

WITH filtered_tweets AS (
    SELECT 
        t.tweet_id,
        t.timestamp,
        t.text,
        t.hashtags,
        t.date,
        u.user_id,
        u.username,
        ue.retweets,
        ue.favorites,
        (ue.retweets + ue.favorites) AS total_engagement
    FROM tweets t
    JOIN user_engagement ue ON t.tweet_id = ue.tweet_id
    JOIN users u ON ue.user_id = u.user_id
    WHERE t.date = '2020-03-01' 
        AND t.hashtags LIKE '%#SocialMedia%'
),
ranked_tweets AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY total_engagement DESC) AS engagement_rank
    FROM filtered_tweets
)
SELECT 
    username,
    user_id,
    tweet_id,
    timestamp,
    text,
    hashtags,
    retweets,
    favorites
FROM ranked_tweets
WHERE engagement_rank <= 3
ORDER BY user_id, total_engagement DESC;

SELECT gf.feature_name AS names, s.study_name AS study_names, dt.tree_name AS decision_tree_names, sf.value AS study_feature_values, fv.value AS decision_tree_feature_values, sv.p_val1 AS p_values_alternative, sv.p_val0 AS p_values_null, sv.test_type AS types_statistical_tests, gf.chromosome AS chromosomal_information, gf.start_position AS start_positions, gf.end_position AS end_positions, dt.accuracy AS accuracy_decision_trees, r.name AS researchers_names, gf.description AS combined_description FROM genomic_features gf JOIN study_features sf ON gf.feature_id = sf.feature_id JOIN studies s ON sf.study_id = s.study_id JOIN feature_values fv ON gf.feature_id = fv.feature_id JOIN decision_trees dt ON fv.tree_id = dt.tree_id JOIN statistical_values sv ON fv.value_id = sv.value_id JOIN researchers r ON s.researcher_id = r.researcher_id ORDER BY dt.accuracy DESC;

WITH MonthlyData AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', ec.datetime) AS month,
        ec.load
    FROM energy_consumption ec
    JOIN regions r ON ec.nuts2_code = r.nuts2_code
    JOIN processes p ON ec.process_id = p.process_id
    JOIN years y ON ec.year_id = y.year_id
    WHERE r.region_name = 'Slovakia - Bratislava'
      AND p.process_name = 'heating_residential'
      AND ec.source_type = 'residential'
      AND ec.subprocess = 'heating_living_room'
      AND ec.energy_source = 'electricity'
      AND y.year = 2010
),
MonthlyAggregates AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(load) AS total_load,
        AVG(load) AS avg_load,
        MAX(load) AS max_load,
        MIN(load) AS min_load
    FROM MonthlyData
    GROUP BY month
),
CategorizedData AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        total_load,
        avg_load,
        max_load,
        min_load,
        CASE 
            WHEN total_load < (SELECT AVG(total_load) FROM MonthlyAggregates) THEN 'Low'
            WHEN total_load > (SELECT AVG(total_load) FROM MonthlyAggregates) * 1.5 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS load_category
    FROM MonthlyAggregates
)
SELECT 
    month,
    total_load,
    avg_load,
    max_load,
    min_load,
    load_category
FROM CategorizedData
ORDER BY 
    CASE load_category
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
        WHEN 'High' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT p.post_id, u.username, p.number_of_votes AS total_votes, p.number_of_comments AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.action_id) AS total_actions, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pa.action_type) AS action_types FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN post_actions pa ON p.post_id = pa.post_id WHERE c.category_name = 'environmental' AND p.number_of_votes > 20 GROUP BY p.post_id, u.username, p.number_of_votes, p.number_of_comments ORDER BY p.post_id;

WITH ranked_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.player_id,
        ps.year,
        ps.runs,
        ps.hits,
        ps.home_runs,
        ps.rbis,
        ps.avg,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.year ORDER BY ps.runs DESC) AS runs_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.year ORDER BY ps.hits DESC) AS hits_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.year ORDER BY ps.home_runs DESC) AS home_runs_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.year ORDER BY ps.rbis DESC) AS rbis_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.year ORDER BY ps.avg DESC) AS avg_rank
    FROM player_statistics ps
    WHERE ps.year = 2023
),
eligible_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_id
    FROM ranked_stats
    WHERE runs_rank <= 3 OR hits_rank <= 3 OR home_runs_rank <= 3 OR rbis_rank <= 3 OR avg_rank <= 3
)
SELECT 
    p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name AS player_name,
    t.team_name,
    rs.runs,
    rs.hits,
    rs.home_runs,
    rs.rbis,
    rs.avg
FROM eligible_players ep
JOIN players p ON ep.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN teams t ON p.team_id = t.team_id
JOIN ranked_stats rs ON ep.player_id = rs.player_id AND rs.year = 2023
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;

WITH RECURSIVE genre_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT genre_id, genre_name, parent_genre_id, genre_name AS hierarchy_path
    FROM genres
    WHERE parent_genre_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT g.genre_id, g.genre_name, g.parent_genre_id, gh.hierarchy_path || ' > ' || g.genre_name
    FROM genres g
    INNER JOIN genre_hierarchy gh ON g.parent_genre_id = gh.genre_id
)
SELECT 
    gh.hierarchy_path AS genre_hierarchy,
    ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS average_rating,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.review_id) AS total_reviews,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards
FROM genre_hierarchy gh
INNER JOIN movie_genres mg ON gh.genre_id = mg.genre_id
INNER JOIN reviews r ON mg.movie_id = r.movie_id
LEFT JOIN awards a ON mg.movie_id = a.movie_id
GROUP BY gh.hierarchy_path
ORDER BY average_rating DESC;

SELECT s.student_id, AVG(sc.average_score) AS mean_score, pr.range_name AS performance_level, (COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'Present' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS attendance_rate, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.course_name) AS subjects FROM students s LEFT JOIN scores sc ON s.student_id = sc.student_id LEFT JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id LEFT JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN performance_ranges pr ON sc.average_score BETWEEN pr.lower_bound AND pr.upper_bound GROUP BY s.student_id, pr.range_name

SELECT j.job_id, j.title AS job_title, c.company_name, l.city || ', ' || l.country AS location, et.type_name AS employment_type, el.level_name AS experience_level, j.years_exp, j.skills, j.salary_range, j.benefits, j.description, j.posted_date, j.deadline, r.name AS recruiter_name, a.applicant_id, a.name AS applicant_name, a.email AS applicant_email, a.application_date, a.phone AS applicant_phone, a.linkedin_profile, a.portfolio_url, ast.status_name AS application_status, COUNT(a.applicant_id) OVER (PARTITION BY j.job_id) AS total_applicants, AVG(CAST(j.years_exp AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY j.job_id) AS avg_years_exp_required FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON j.company_id = c.company_id JOIN locations l ON j.location = l.location_id JOIN employment_types et ON j.type = et.type_id JOIN experience_levels el ON j.level = el.level_id JOIN recruiters r ON j.recruiter_id = r.recruiter_id LEFT JOIN applicants a ON j.job_id = a.job_id LEFT JOIN application_status ast ON a.status_id = ast.status_id ORDER BY j.job_id, a.applicant_id;

SELECT e.event_id, e.ride_date, t.team_name, r.rank, r.completion_status, r.average_speed, e.distance_ridden, e.time, bc.class_name AS bicycle_class, e.location, e.event_type, e.registration_open_date, e.event_status, COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_id) AS number_of_teams, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completion_status = 'FIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completions, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completion_status != 'FIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_completions, AVG(r.average_speed) AS avg_speed_overall, MIN(e.sortable_time) AS min_event_time, MAX(e.sortable_time) AS max_event_time, r.rank AS final_rank FROM events e LEFT JOIN results r ON e.event_id = r.event_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON r.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN bicycle_classes bc ON e.bicycle_class = bc.class_name GROUP BY e.event_id, t.team_id ORDER BY e.event_id, r.rank

SELECT u.user_name, AVG(o.total_cost) AS avg_total_cost FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN departments d ON p.department_id = d.department_id JOIN order_frequency of ON u.user_id = of.user_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Food' AND of.reordered = 1 GROUP BY u.user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 3 ORDER BY avg_total_cost DESC;

SELECT 
    pb.batch_id,
    c.defect_description,
    o.operator_name,
    a.system_name,
    pb.ai_date,
    pb.ai_time,
    COUNT(c.component_id) AS defect_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pb.batch_id ORDER BY COUNT(c.component_id) DESC) AS defect_rank
FROM production_batches pb
LEFT JOIN components c ON pb.batch_id = c.batch_id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON pb.ai_operator = o.operator_name
LEFT JOIN ai_systems a ON pb.ai_system = a.system_name
WHERE c.defect_description IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pb.batch_id, c.defect_description
ORDER BY pb.batch_id, defect_rank;

WITH team_batting AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.match_id,
        tc.team_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT tc.player_id) AS player_count,
        SUM(CAST(pmr.batting_score AS INTEGER)) AS total_runs
    FROM team_compositions tc
    LEFT JOIN player_match_records pmr ON tc.match_id = pmr.match_id AND tc.player_id = pmr.player_id
    GROUP BY tc.match_id, tc.team_id
),
team_bowling AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.match_id,
        tc.team_id,
        SUM(pmr.bowling_runs) AS total_runs_conceded,
        SUM(pmr.bowling_wickets) AS total_wickets_taken
    FROM team_compositions tc
    LEFT JOIN player_match_records pmr ON tc.match_id = pmr.match_id AND tc.player_id = pmr.player_id
    GROUP BY tc.match_id, tc.team_id
),
team_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        tb.match_id,
        tb.team_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN tb.player_count > 0 THEN CAST(tb.total_runs AS REAL) / tb.player_count
            ELSE 0
        END AS batting_average,
        CASE 
            WHEN tw.total_wickets_taken > 0 THEN CAST(tw.total_runs_conceded AS REAL) / tw.total_wickets_taken
            ELSE 0
        END AS bowling_average
    FROM team_batting tb
    JOIN team_bowling tw ON tb.match_id = tw.match_id AND tb.team_id = tw.team_id
)
SELECT 
    match_id,
    team_id,
    batting_average,
    bowling_average,
    (batting_average + bowling_average) AS combined_average
FROM team_averages
ORDER BY combined_average DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH RECURSIVE page_tree AS (
  SELECT 
    p.page_id,
    p.name,
    p.path,
    0 AS level,
    p.path AS full_path
  FROM pages p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM page_hierarchy ph WHERE ph.child_page_id = p.page_id
  )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    p.page_id,
    p.name,
    p.path,
    pt.level + 1 AS level,
    pt.full_path || '/' || p.path AS full_path
  FROM pages p
  INNER JOIN page_hierarchy ph ON p.page_id = ph.child_page_id
  INNER JOIN page_tree pt ON ph.parent_page_id = pt.page_id
),
page_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.page_id,
    COUNT(pv.view_id) AS total_views,
    AVG(pv.view_duration) AS avg_view_duration,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pv.user_id) AS unique_visitors
  FROM pages p
  LEFT JOIN page_views pv ON p.page_id = pv.page_id
  GROUP BY p.page_id
),
user_interactions AS (
  SELECT 
    p.page_id,
    u.user_id,
    u.username,
    u.role,
    COUNT(pv.view_id) AS views_by_user,
    AVG(pv.view_duration) AS avg_duration_per_user
  FROM pages p
  LEFT JOIN page_views pv ON p.page_id = pv.page_id
  LEFT JOIN users u ON pv.user_id = u.user_id
  GROUP BY p.page_id, u.user_id, u.username, u.role
)
SELECT 
  pt.name,
  pt.path,
  pt.level,
  pt.full_path,
  pp.load_time,
  pp.bounce_rate,
  pp.exit_rate,
  ps.total_views,
  ps.avg_view_duration,
  ps.unique_visitors,
  ui.username,
  ui.role,
  ui.views_by_user,
  ui.avg_duration_per_user
FROM page_tree pt
LEFT JOIN page_performance pp ON pt.page_id = pp.page_id
LEFT JOIN page_stats ps ON pt.page_id = ps.page_id
LEFT JOIN user_interactions ui ON pt.page_id = ui.page_id
ORDER BY pt.level, pt.full_path;

WITH CategoryPaths AS (
    SELECT 
        c1.category_id,
        COALESCE(c2.category_name || ' > ' || c1.category_name, c1.category_name) AS category_path
    FROM categories c1
    LEFT JOIN categories c2 ON c1.parent_category_id = c2.category_id
),
ActivityStats AS (
    SELECT 
        la.activity_id,
        la.course_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ar.student_id) AS total_students,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN ar.status = 'present' THEN 1 END) AS attendance_present,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN ar.status = 'absent' THEN 1 END) AS attendance_absent,
        AVG(f.rating) AS avg_feedback_rating
    FROM learning_activities la
    LEFT JOIN attendance_records ar ON la.activity_id = ar.activity_id
    LEFT JOIN feedback f ON la.activity_id = f.activity_id
    GROUP BY la.activity_id, la.course_id
),
RankedActivities AS (
    SELECT 
        la.activity_id,
        la.course_id,
        as2.avg_feedback_rating,
        as2.total_students,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.course_id ORDER BY as2.avg_feedback_rating DESC) AS rank_within_course
    FROM learning_activities la
    JOIN ActivityStats as2 ON la.activity_id = as2.activity_id
)
SELECT 
    la.activity_id,
    cp.category_path,
    la.activity_type_id,
    la.number_of_sessions,
    la.length,
    la.student_hours,
    la.comments,
    c.course_id,
    c.course_name,
    c.department_id,
    c.credits,
    c.prerequisites,
    c.learning_outcomes,
    u.user_id AS instructor_id,
    u.first_name AS instructor_first_name,
    u.last_name AS instructor_last_name,
    as2.total_students,
    as2.attendance_present,
    as2.attendance_absent,
    as2.avg_feedback_rating,
    ra.rank_within_course
FROM learning_activities la
JOIN CategoryPaths cp ON la.category_id = cp.category_id
JOIN courses c ON la.course_id = c.course_id
JOIN users u ON la.instructor_id = u.user_id
JOIN ActivityStats as2 ON la.activity_id = as2.activity_id
JOIN RankedActivities ra ON la.activity_id = ra.activity_id
ORDER BY ra.rank_within_course, ra.total_students DESC;

WITH config_success_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        dgc.connector,
        dgc.config_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN dgl.status = 'success' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS success_rate
    FROM data_generation_configs dgc
    LEFT JOIN data_generation_logs dgl ON dgc.config_id = dgl.config_id
    GROUP BY dgc.connector, dgc.config_id
),
best_configs AS (
    SELECT 
        connector,
        MAX(success_rate) AS best_success_rate
    FROM config_success_rates
    GROUP BY connector
)
SELECT 
    csr.connector,
    AVG(csr.success_rate) AS avg_success_rate,
    bc.best_success_rate,
    AVG(csr.success_rate) / bc.best_success_rate AS relative_performance,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(csr.success_rate) / bc.best_success_rate DESC) AS performance_rank
FROM config_success_rates csr
JOIN best_configs bc ON csr.connector = bc.connector
GROUP BY csr.connector
ORDER BY performance_rank;

WITH OlympicSwimmers AS (
    SELECT 
        s.swimmer_id,
        s.first_name,
        s.last_name,
        s.nationality,
        r.time,
        r.nisca_score
    FROM swimmers s
    JOIN results r ON s.swimmer_id = r.swimmer_id
    JOIN events e ON r.event_id = e.event_id
    WHERE e.is_olympic = 1
),
RankedSwimmers AS (
    SELECT 
        swimmer_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        nationality,
        AVG(CAST(time AS REAL)) AS avg_time,
        AVG(nisca_score) AS avg_nisca_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nationality ORDER BY AVG(CAST(time AS REAL)) ASC, AVG(nisca_score) DESC) AS rank_within_nationality
    FROM OlympicSwimmers
    GROUP BY swimmer_id, first_name, last_name, nationality
)
SELECT 
    first_name,
    last_name,
    nationality,
    avg_time,
    avg_nisca_score
FROM RankedSwimmers
WHERE rank_within_nationality <= 5
ORDER BY nationality, avg_time ASC, avg_nisca_score DESC;

        rows_per_second,
        number_of_rows,
        created_by,
        created_at,
        updated_at,
        description,
        is_active
    FROM data_generation_configs
),
user_info AS (
    SELECT 
        u.user_id,
        u.username,
        u.email,
        u.role_id
    FROM users u
),
log_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        config_id,
        user_id,
        COUNT(log_id) AS log_count,
        AVG(CAST(duration AS REAL)) AS avg_duration,
        SUM(CAST(duration AS REAL)) AS total_duration
    FROM data_generation_logs
    GROUP BY config_id, user_id
),
dataset_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        config_id,
        COUNT(dataset_id) AS dataset_count,
        SUM(CAST(size_in_bytes AS INTEGER)) AS total_size_bytes,
        AVG(quality_score) AS avg_quality_score
    FROM generated_datasets
    GROUP BY config_id
),
quality_percentiles AS (
    SELECT 
        config_id,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_quality_score) AS quality_score_percentile
    FROM dataset_metrics
)
SELECT 
    cd.*,
    ui.username,
    ui.email,
    ui.role_id,
    COALESCE(ls.log_count, 0) AS log_count,
    COALESCE(ls.avg_duration, 0) AS avg_duration,
    COALESCE(ls.total_duration, 0) AS total_duration,
    COALESCE(dm.dataset_count, 0) AS dataset_count,
    COALESCE(dm.total_size_bytes, 0) AS total_size_bytes,
    COALESCE(dm.avg_quality_score, 0) AS avg_quality_score,
    COALESCE(qp.quality_score_percentile, 0) AS quality_score_percentile
FROM config_details cd
LEFT JOIN user_info ui ON cd.created_by = ui.user_id
LEFT JOIN log_stats ls ON cd.config_id = ls.config_id AND cd.created_by = ls.user_id
LEFT JOIN dataset_metrics dm ON cd.config_id = dm.config_id
LEFT JOIN quality_percentiles qp ON cd.config_id = qp.config_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(ls.total_duration, 0) DESC, COALESCE(qp.quality_score_percentile, 0) DESC;

WITH sales_by_decade AS (
    SELECT 
        d.decade_id,
        d.decade_name,
        m.manufacturer_id,
        m.manufacturer_name,
        cm.model_id,
        cm.model_name,
        cs.sale_region,
        COUNT(cs.sale_id) AS total_sales
    FROM car_sales cs
    JOIN car_models cm ON cs.model_id = cm.model_id
    JOIN manufacturers m ON cm.manufacturer_id = m.manufacturer_id
    JOIN decades d ON CAST(SUBSTR(cs.sale_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN d.start_year AND d.end_year
    GROUP BY d.decade_id, m.manufacturer_id, cm.model_id, cs.sale_region
),
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        curr.decade_id,
        curr.decade_name,
        curr.manufacturer_id,
        curr.manufacturer_name,
        curr.model_id,
        curr.model_name,
        curr.sale_region,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev.total_sales IS NULL OR prev.total_sales = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((CAST(curr.total_sales AS REAL) - CAST(prev.total_sales AS REAL)) / CAST(prev.total_sales AS REAL) * 100, 2)
        END AS sales_growth_rate
    FROM sales_by_decade curr
    LEFT JOIN sales_by_decade prev ON curr.manufacturer_id = prev.manufacturer_id 
        AND curr.model_id = prev.model_id 
        AND curr.sale_region = prev.sale_region 
        AND curr.decade_id = prev.decade_id + 1
)
SELECT 
    decade_name,
    manufacturer_name,
    model_name,
    sale_region,
    sales_growth_rate
FROM growth_rates
WHERE sales_growth_rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY decade_name, manufacturer_name, model_name, sale_region, sales_growth_rate DESC;

WITH RECURSIVE category_paths AS (
    SELECT category_id, category_name, CAST(category_name AS TEXT) AS full_path
    FROM categories
    WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, cp.full_path || ' > ' || c.category_name
    FROM categories c
    INNER JOIN category_paths cp ON c.parent_category_id = cp.category_id
),
last_accesses AS (
    SELECT item_id, user_id, access_date, access_type, access_reason,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY access_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM item_access_logs
),
vote_counts AS (
    SELECT item_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN vote_cast = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_votes,
           SUM(CASE WHEN vote_cast = 'no' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_votes,
           SUM(CASE WHEN vote_cast = 'abstain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abstain_votes
    FROM votes
    GROUP BY item_id
)
SELECT pi.item_id,
       pi.title,
       cp.full_path AS category_full_path,
       pi.tabled_date,
       pi.plenary_date,
       pi.item_type,
       pi.description,
       pi.status,
       si.sequence_number,
       si.session_id,
       la.user_id AS last_access_user_id,
       la.access_date AS last_access_date,
       la.access_type AS last_access_type,
       la.access_reason AS last_access_reason,
       COALESCE(vc.yes_votes, 0) AS yes_votes,
       COALESCE(vc.no_votes, 0) AS no_votes,
       COALESCE(vc.abstain_votes, 0) AS abstain_votes
FROM plenary_items pi
LEFT JOIN category_paths cp ON pi.category_id = cp.category_id
LEFT JOIN session_items si ON pi.item_id = si.item_id
LEFT JOIN last_accesses la ON pi.item_id = la.item_id AND la.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN vote_counts vc ON pi.item_id = vc.item_id
ORDER BY si.sequence_number, pi.item_id;

WITH ranked_reports AS (
    SELECT 
        r.report_id,
        r.summary,
        r.user_id,
        r.metric_type_id,
        r.report_date,
        r.status,
        m.description AS metric_description,
        m.unit AS unit_of_measurement,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.user_id ORDER BY r.report_date DESC) AS report_rank
    FROM reports r
    JOIN metrics m ON r.metric_type_id = m.metric_id
    WHERE r.status = 'published'
),
user_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        rr.user_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rr.metric_type_id) AS total_metrics,
        AVG(em.value) AS average_value
    FROM ranked_reports rr
    JOIN environmental_metrics em ON rr.metric_type_id = em.metric_type_id
    WHERE rr.report_rank <= 3
    GROUP BY rr.user_id
)
SELECT 
    u.username,
    rr.summary,
    rr.metric_description,
    rr.unit_of_measurement,
    um.total_metrics,
    um.average_value
FROM ranked_reports rr
JOIN users u ON rr.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user_metrics um ON rr.user_id = um.user_id
WHERE rr.report_rank <= 3
ORDER BY u.username, rr.report_date DESC;

SELECT 
    t.team_name,
    pm.season,
    AVG(pm.batting_average) AS avg_batting_average,
    AVG(pm.ops) AS avg_ops,
    SUM(pm.strikeouts) AS total_strikeouts,
    AVG(pm.on_base_percentage) AS avg_on_base_percentage,
    SUM(pm.runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(pm.at_bats) AS total_at_bats,
    SUM(pm.home_runs) AS total_home_runs,
    SUM(pm.rbi) AS total_rbi,
    AVG(g.attendance) AS avg_attendance,
    AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(g.score, 1, INSTR(g.score, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER) + CAST(SUBSTR(g.score, INSTR(g.score, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER)) / 2.0 AS avg_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN g.winning_team = t.team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS games_won,
    SUM(CASE WHEN g.losing_team = t.team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS games_lost,
    COUNT(g.game_id) AS total_games_played,
    AVG(c.experience_years) AS avg_coaching_experience,
    SUM(pm.runs) AS cumulative_runs,
    SUM(pm.home_runs) AS cumulative_home_runs,
    SUM(pm.rbi) AS cumulative_rbi,
    AVG(pm.ops) AS cumulative_ops,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(pm.at_bats) > 0 THEN SUM(pm.hits) * 1.0 / SUM(pm.at_bats)
        ELSE 0
    END AS cumulative_batting_average
FROM teams t
LEFT JOIN players p ON t.team_name = p.team AND p.contract_status = 'Signed'
LEFT JOIN performance_metrics pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id AND pm.season = '2023'
LEFT JOIN games g ON (g.winning_team = t.team_name OR g.losing_team = t.team_name) AND strftime('%Y', g.date) = '2023'
LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.team_id = c.team_id
WHERE pm.season IS NOT NULL OR g.game_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.team_name, pm.season
ORDER BY t.team_name ASC, pm.season DESC;

WITH most_common_situation AS (
    SELECT test_situation
    FROM experiments
    GROUP BY test_situation
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
most_common_condition AS (
    SELECT condition
    FROM experiments
    GROUP BY condition
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
subject_most_experiments AS (
    SELECT subject_id
    FROM experiments
    GROUP BY subject_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
filtered_experiments AS (
    SELECT e.researcher_id, e.correct
    FROM experiments e
    JOIN most_common_situation mcs ON e.test_situation = mcs.test_situation
    JOIN most_common_condition mcc ON e.condition = mcc.condition
    JOIN subject_most_experiments sme ON e.subject_id = sme.subject_id
),
researcher_success_rates AS (
    SELECT r.researcher_id, r.researcher_name,
           ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fe.correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate
    FROM filtered_experiments fe
    JOIN researchers r ON fe.researcher_id = r.researcher_id
    GROUP BY r.researcher_id, r.researcher_name
)
SELECT researcher_name, success_rate
FROM researcher_success_rates
ORDER BY success_rate DESC
LIMIT 10

        e.employee_id,

        1 AS level,

        e.department,

    FROM employees e
    WHERE e.manager_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        e.employee_id,
        e.employee_name,

WITH most_compared_edition AS (
    SELECT e.edition_id, e.edition_name, COUNT(c.comparison_id) AS comparison_count
    FROM editions e
    JOIN comparisons c ON ',' || c.selected_editions || ',' LIKE '%,' || e.edition_id || ',%'
    GROUP BY e.edition_id, e.edition_name
    ORDER BY comparison_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
edition_features_count AS (
    SELECT mce.edition_id, mce.edition_name, COUNT(ef.feature_id) AS feature_count
    FROM most_compared_edition mce
    JOIN edition_features ef ON mce.edition_id = ef.edition_id
    WHERE ef.is_available = 1
    GROUP BY mce.edition_id, mce.edition_name
),
feature_usage AS (
    SELECT mce.edition_id, ef.feature_id, COUNT(c.comparison_id) AS usage_count
    FROM most_compared_edition mce
    JOIN edition_features ef ON mce.edition_id = ef.edition_id
    JOIN comparisons c ON ',' || c.selected_editions || ',' LIKE '%,' || mce.edition_id || ',%'
    WHERE ef.is_available = 1
    GROUP BY mce.edition_id, ef.feature_id
)
SELECT 
    mce.edition_name AS most_frequently_compared_edition,
    efc.feature_count,
    ROUND(AVG(fu.usage_count), 2) AS average_feature_usage_in_comparisons
FROM most_compared_edition mce
JOIN edition_features_count efc ON mce.edition_id = efc.edition_id
JOIN feature_usage fu ON mce.edition_id = fu.edition_id
GROUP BY mce.edition_id, mce.edition_name, efc.feature_count;

WITH filtered_loan_types AS (
    SELECT loan_type_id
    FROM loan_types
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(interest_rate_range, 1, INSTR(interest_rate_range, '%') - 1) AS REAL) BETWEEN 3 AND 7
),
ranked_applications AS (
    SELECT 
        la.application_id,
        la.loan_type_id,
        la.risk_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.loan_type_id ORDER BY la.risk_score ASC) AS rank
    FROM loan_applications la
    INNER JOIN filtered_loan_types flt ON la.loan_type_id = flt.loan_type_id
    WHERE la.status = 'approved'
)
SELECT application_id
FROM ranked_applications
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY loan_type_id, rank;

SELECT u.user_name AS name, u.role, up.name AS permission, d.name AS dbms_name, dm.name AS dbms_type, CASE WHEN dr.is_major_release = 1 THEN 'Major' ELSE 'Minor' END AS release_type, dr.version, dr.release_date, COUNT(dr.dbms_release_id) AS release_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_role_mappings urm ON u.user_id = urm.user_id LEFT JOIN role_permission_mappings rpm ON urm.role_id = rpm.role_id LEFT JOIN user_permissions up ON rpm.permission_id = up.permission_id LEFT JOIN dbms d ON u.user_id = d.user_id LEFT JOIN dbms_models dm ON d.dbms_model_id = dm.dbms_model_id LEFT JOIN dbms_releases dr ON d.dbms_id = dr.dbms_id AND dr.release_date >= '2022-01-01' AND dr.release_date < '2023-01-01' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.role, up.name, d.name, dm.name, dr.is_major_release, dr.version, dr.release_date ORDER BY u.user_name ASC, dr.release_date DESC

SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN ep.timestamp < m.timestamp THEN (ep.power_out / NULLIF(ep.power_usage, 0)) * 100 ELSE NULL END) AS avg_efficiency_before_maintenance,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ep.timestamp >= m.timestamp THEN (ep.power_out / NULLIF(ep.power_usage, 0)) * 100 ELSE NULL END) AS avg_efficiency_after_maintenance
FROM energy_production ep
JOIN maintenance m ON ep.panel_id = m.panel_id
WHERE ep.panel_id = 0 AND m.maintenance_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY ep.panel_id

WITH filtered_content AS (
    SELECT 
        c.content_id,
        c.title,
        c.cast,
        c.rating AS content_rating,
        c.runtime,
        c.release_year,
        g.genre_id,
        g.genre_name,
        AVG(cr.rating_score) AS avg_genre_rating
    FROM content c
    JOIN content_genres cg ON c.content_id = cg.content_id
    JOIN genres g ON cg.genre_id = g.genre_id
    JOIN content_ratings cr ON c.content_id = cr.content_id
    JOIN content_tags ct ON c.content_id = ct.content_id
    WHERE g.genre_name IN ('Comedy', 'Drama')
        AND ct.tag_name IN ('80s', '90s')
        AND c.rating >= 4.0
    GROUP BY c.content_id, g.genre_id, g.genre_name
),
actor_split AS (
    SELECT 
        fc.content_id,
        fc.genre_name,
        fc.avg_genre_rating,
        fc.runtime,
        fc.release_year,
        fc.content_rating,
        LOWER(TRIM(value)) AS actor
    FROM filtered_content fc,
    json_each('[' || REPLACE(REPLACE(fc.cast, '"', ''), ',', '","') || ']')
),
ranked_actors AS (
    SELECT 
        actor,
        genre_name,
        avg_genre_rating,
        runtime,
        release_year,
        content_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY genre_name ORDER BY content_rating DESC) AS actor_rank
    FROM actor_split
    GROUP BY actor, genre_name, avg_genre_rating, runtime, release_year, content_rating
)
SELECT 
    actor AS top_actor,
    genre_name,
    ROUND(avg_genre_rating, 2) AS average_rating,
    runtime,
    release_year,
    COUNT(*) AS appearances
FROM ranked_actors
WHERE actor_rank = 1
ORDER BY content_rating DESC;

WITH top_teams AS (
    SELECT team_id
    FROM teams
    WHERE rank <= 3
    ORDER BY rank
    LIMIT 3
),
user_activity AS (
    SELECT 
        al.user_id,
        al.team_id,
        al.access_date,
        al.duration,
        SUBSTR(u.user_name, 1, 15) AS user_name_short,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY al.team_id ORDER BY al.duration DESC) AS activity_rank
    FROM access_logs al
    JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.user_id
    WHERE al.team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM top_teams)
)
SELECT 
    user_name_short,
    access_date,
    activity_rank
FROM user_activity
WHERE activity_rank <= 3
ORDER BY access_date DESC, activity_rank;

SELECT DISTINCT f.feature_name FROM editions e JOIN edition_features ef ON e.edition_id = ef.edition_id JOIN features f ON ef.feature_id = f.feature_id JOIN comparisons c ON c.selected_editions LIKE '%' || e.edition_id || '%' JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id JOIN user_roles ur ON u.role = ur.role_name WHERE e.is_popular = 1 AND ef.is_available = 1 AND json_extract(ur.permissions, '$.can_recommend') = 1

SELECT strftime('%Y', contract_start) AS season, SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM player_contract WHERE team_id = 0 GROUP BY season HAVING total_salary > 0 ORDER BY season

SELECT customer_id, service_id, SUM(usage_amount) AS total_usage, MIN(usage_amount) AS min_usage, MAX(usage_amount) AS max_usage, AVG(usage_amount) AS avg_usage FROM usage GROUP BY customer_id, service_id ORDER BY customer_id, service_id

WITH RECURSIVE employee_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        e.employee_id,
        e.first_name,
        e.last_name,
        e.department_id,
        e.supervisor_id,
        p.position_id,
        p.position_name,
        p.salary_range,
        0 AS level
    FROM employees e
    JOIN positions p ON e.position_id = p.position_id
    WHERE e.supervisor_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        e.employee_id,
        e.first_name,
        e.last_name,
        e.department_id,
        e.supervisor_id,
        p.position_id,
        p.position_name,
        p.salary_range,
        eh.level + 1 AS level
    FROM employees e
    JOIN positions p ON e.position_id = p.position_id
    JOIN employee_hierarchy eh ON e.supervisor_id = eh.employee_id
)
SELECT 
    eh.department_id,
    eh.level,
    eh.employee_id,
    eh.first_name,
    eh.last_name,
    eh.position_name,
    eh.salary_range,
    SUM(CAST(SUBSTR(eh.salary_range, INSTR(eh.salary_range, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER)) OVER (
        PARTITION BY eh.department_id 
        ORDER BY eh.level, eh.last_name, eh.first_name
    ) AS cumulative_salary
FROM employee_hierarchy eh
ORDER BY eh.department_id, eh.level, eh.last_name, eh.first_name;

SELECT r.revision_id, r.revision_date, uc.user_name AS created_by, ua.user_name AS approved_by, a.access_date, a.access_type, a.ip_address, a.user_agent, u.user_name AS access_user, p.pin_name, p.io_type, p.functionality, pp.notes FROM revisions r LEFT JOIN users uc ON r.created_by = uc.user_id LEFT JOIN users ua ON r.approved_by = ua.user_id LEFT JOIN access_logs a ON r.design_id = a.design_id LEFT JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN design_pins dp ON r.design_id = dp.design_id LEFT JOIN pins p ON dp.pin_id = p.pin_id LEFT JOIN picture_pins pp ON p.pin_id = pp.pin_id WHERE r.design_id = 1 ORDER BY r.revision_date, a.access_date, p.pin_name;

WITH category_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_id,
        c.category_name,
        c.parent_category,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.parent_category IS NULL THEN c.category_name
            ELSE c.parent_category || ' > ' || c.category_name
        END AS full_path
    FROM categories c
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.category_name,
        cp.full_path,
        s.maker,
        s.store_id,
        SUM(s.sales_amount) AS total_sales
    FROM sales_data s
    JOIN category_paths cp ON s.category1 = cp.category_name
    GROUP BY cp.category_name, cp.full_path, s.maker, s.store_id
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        category_name,
        full_path,
        maker,
        store_id,
        total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name, store_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT 
    rs.category_name,
    rs.full_path,
    m.maker_name AS manufacturer,
    rs.total_sales
FROM ranked_sales rs
JOIN makers m ON rs.maker = m.maker_name
WHERE rs.sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY rs.category_name, rs.store_id;

SELECT 
    jp.job_id,
    jp.job_title,
    c.category_name,
    l.location_name,
    l.contact_email,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.application_id) AS total_applications,
    a.status AS application_status,
    COUNT(a.application_id) AS status_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM user_skills us 
            WHERE us.user_id = a.user_id 
            AND us.skill IN (
                SELECT value 
                FROM json_each('[' || REPLACE(jp.skills_required, ', ', ',') || ']')
            )
        ) THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS skills_match
FROM job_postings jp
LEFT JOIN categories c ON jp.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN locations l ON jp.location_id = l.location_id
LEFT JOIN applications a ON jp.job_id = a.job_id
GROUP BY jp.job_id, a.status
ORDER BY jp.job_id, a.status;

SELECT ws.station_name, AVG(cc.cloud_cover) AS average_cloud_cover FROM weather_stations ws JOIN weather_data wd ON ws.station_id = wd.station_id JOIN cloud_cover cc ON wd.data_id = cc.data_id WHERE wd.year_id = 2023 GROUP BY ws.station_id, ws.station_name HAVING AVG(cc.cloud_cover) > 0.5 ORDER BY ws.station_name;
SELECT g.group_name, COUNT(pt.element_id) AS element_count FROM groups g LEFT JOIN periodic_table pt ON g.group_id = pt.group_id GROUP BY g.group_id, g.group_name ORDER BY element_count DESC

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', published_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS total_cves, MIN(published_date) AS earliest_publication_date, MAX(published_date) AS latest_publication_date FROM cves WHERE published_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT u.user_name, COUNT(c.correction_id) AS contribution_count FROM users u JOIN corrections c ON u.user_id = c.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name ORDER BY contribution_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.name AS pokemon_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.ability_name) AS abilities, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.move_name) AS moves FROM pokemon p LEFT JOIN pokemon_abilities pa ON p.pokemon_id = pa.pokemon_id LEFT JOIN abilities a ON pa.ability_id = a.ability_id LEFT JOIN pokemon_moves pm ON p.pokemon_id = pm.pokemon_id LEFT JOIN moves m ON pm.move_id = m.move_id GROUP BY p.pokemon_id, p.name ORDER BY p.name;

SELECT j.title, AVG(if.impact_factor_value) AS average_impact_factor, COUNT(DISTINCT a.article_id) AS article_count FROM journals j JOIN impact_factors if ON j.journal_id = if.journal_id JOIN journal_issues ji ON j.journal_id = ji.journal_id JOIN articles a ON ji.issue_id = a.issue_id WHERE j.status = 'active' GROUP BY j.journal_id, j.title HAVING AVG(if.impact_factor_value) > 2.0

SELECT wu.wire_type_id, SUM(wu.quantity_used) AS total_quantity_used, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.location) AS plant_locations FROM wire_usage wu JOIN inventory i ON wu.wire_type_id = i.wire_type_id JOIN plants p ON i.plant_id = p.plant_id WHERE wu.wire_type_id IN (SELECT wire_type_id FROM wire_usage GROUP BY wire_type_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT model_id) > 1) GROUP BY wu.wire_type_id ORDER BY wu.wire_type_id;

SELECT cbsa.cbsa_code, business_types.type_name, AVG(CAST(businesses.amount_assisted AS REAL) / cbsa.cbsa_population) AS avg_assistance_per_capita FROM businesses JOIN business_types ON businesses.business_type = business_types.type_id JOIN cbsa ON businesses.cbsa = cbsa.cbsa_id WHERE businesses.amount_assisted IS NOT NULL AND cbsa.cbsa_population IS NOT NULL AND cbsa.cbsa_population > 0 GROUP BY cbsa.cbsa_code, business_types.type_name ORDER BY avg_assistance_per_capita DESC

SELECT n.neighborhood_name, c.citation_year, c.citation_month, COUNT(c.citation_id) AS total_citations, AVG(CAST(c.fine_amount AS REAL)) AS average_fine_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.vehicle_plate) AS unique_vehicles_cited FROM citations c JOIN neighborhoods n ON c.neighborhood_id = n.neighborhood_id WHERE c.citation_year = (SELECT MAX(citation_year) FROM citations) GROUP BY n.neighborhood_name, c.citation_year, c.citation_month ORDER BY n.neighborhood_name, c.citation_year, c.citation_month;

SELECT li.probability FROM loot_items li JOIN loot_conditions lc ON li.item_id = lc.item_id JOIN characters c ON c.character_id = 1 WHERE li.item_id = 1 AND li.bucket_id = 1 AND lc.condition_type = 'character_level' AND CASE lc.condition_operator WHEN '=' THEN c.character_level = CAST(lc.condition_value AS INTEGER) WHEN '<' THEN c.character_level < CAST(lc.condition_value AS INTEGER) WHEN '>' THEN c.character_level > CAST(lc.condition_value AS INTEGER) WHEN '<=' THEN c.character_level <= CAST(lc.condition_value AS INTEGER) WHEN '>=' THEN c.character_level >= CAST(lc.condition_value AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END = 1;

SELECT at.attack_type_name, COUNT(a.attack_id) AS number_of_attacks FROM attacks a JOIN groups g ON a.group_id = g.group_id JOIN attack_types at ON a.attack_type_id = at.attack_type_id WHERE g.group_name = 'ISIS' GROUP BY at.attack_type_name ORDER BY number_of_attacks DESC;

SELECT u.user_name AS name, e.entity_name AS entity, y.year_name AS year, AVG(al.session_duration) AS average_duration, COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count, y.global_economic_conditions, y.major_events FROM access_logs al JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.user_id JOIN entities e ON al.data_id = e.entity_id JOIN years y ON CAST(SUBSTR(al.access_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = y.year_name WHERE u.status = 'active' AND y.year_name = 1970 GROUP BY u.user_id, e.entity_id HAVING COUNT(al.access_id) > 1 ORDER BY u.user_name, e.entity_name;

WITH user_preferences_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        preferred_genre,
        preferred_tempo_range,
        preferred_loudness_range,
        preferred_key
    FROM user_preferences
    WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE country = 'United States')
),
engagement_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        t.track_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT tal.user_id) AS unique_listeners,
        COUNT(tr.rating_id) AS total_ratings,
        AVG(tr.rating) AS avg_rating,
        COUNT(tc.comment_id) AS total_comments
    FROM tracks t
    LEFT JOIN track_access_logs tal ON t.track_id = tal.track_id
    LEFT JOIN track_ratings tr ON t.track_id = tr.track_id
    LEFT JOIN track_comments tc ON t.track_id = tc.track_id
    GROUP BY t.track_id
),
match_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        t.track_id,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN up.preferred_genre IS NOT NULL AND t.track_title LIKE '%' || up.preferred_genre || '%' THEN 1.0 
                ELSE 0.0 
            END +
            CASE 
                WHEN up.preferred_tempo_range IS NOT NULL AND 
                     t.tempo BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTR(up.preferred_tempo_range, 1, INSTR(up.preferred_tempo_range, '-')-1) AS REAL) 
                                 AND CAST(SUBSTR(up.preferred_tempo_range, INSTR(up.preferred_tempo_range, '-')+1) AS REAL) THEN 1.0 
                ELSE 0.0 
            END +
            CASE 
                WHEN up.preferred_loudness_range IS NOT NULL AND 
                     t.loudness BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTR(up.preferred_loudness_range, 1, INSTR(up.preferred_loudness_range, '-')-1) AS REAL) 
                                    AND CAST(SUBSTR(up.preferred_loudness_range, INSTR(up.preferred_loudness_range, '-')+1) AS REAL) THEN 1.0 
                ELSE 0.0 
            END +
            CASE 
                WHEN up.preferred_key IS NOT NULL AND t.key = CAST(up.preferred_key AS INTEGER) THEN 1.0 
                ELSE 0.0 
            END
        ) AS match_score
    FROM tracks t
    CROSS JOIN user_preferences_agg up
    GROUP BY t.track_id
),
final_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        t.track_id,
        t.track_title,
        COALESCE(ms.match_score, 0) * 0.4 + 
        COALESCE(em.avg_rating, 0) * 0.3 + 
        COALESCE(em.total_comments, 0) * 0.2 + 
        COALESCE(em.unique_listeners, 0) * 0.1 AS final_score
    FROM tracks t
    LEFT JOIN match_scores ms ON t.track_id = ms.track_id
    LEFT JOIN engagement_metrics em ON t.track_id = em.track_id
)
SELECT 
    track_id,
    track_title,
    final_score
FROM final_scores
ORDER BY final_score DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.config_id, c.config_version, (COUNT(CASE WHEN bl.build_status = 'Success' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS success_rate FROM configurations c JOIN build_logs bl ON c.config_id = bl.config_id GROUP BY c.config_id, c.config_version HAVING success_rate > 75 ORDER BY success_rate DESC

SELECT e.exit_name, e.exit_type, e.exit_capacity, e.is_emergency_only, COALESCE(SUM(sr.number_of_students), 0) AS total_students, COALESCE(AVG(sr.average_exit_time), 0) AS avg_exit_time, COALESCE(sr.bottleneck_report, 'No bottlenecks identified') AS bottleneck_report FROM exits e JOIN floors f ON e.floor_id = f.floor_id JOIN buildings b ON f.building_id = b.building_id LEFT JOIN simulation_results sr ON e.exit_id = sr.exit_id WHERE b.building_name = 'Office Building' AND b.city = 'Othertown' GROUP BY e.exit_id ORDER BY total_students DESC, avg_exit_time ASC;

SELECT ws.station_name, u.user_name, AVG(wd.value) AS avg_precipitation, COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_log_count, ws.location, ws.last_maintenance_date FROM weather_stations ws JOIN weather_data wd ON ws.station_id = wd.station_id JOIN parameters p ON wd.parameter_id = p.parameter_id JOIN access_logs al ON wd.data_id = al.data_id JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.parameter_name = 'precipitation' GROUP BY ws.station_id, u.user_id HAVING AVG(wd.value) > 50 ORDER BY avg_precipitation DESC

SELECT p.player_name, t.team_name, p.position, AVG(ps.batting_average) AS avg_batting_average, AVG(ps.on_base_percentage) AS avg_on_base_percentage FROM players p JOIN player_stats ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id JOIN games g ON ps.game_id = g.game_id JOIN teams t ON p.team_id = t.team_id WHERE strftime('%Y', g.game_date) = '2023' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, t.team_name, p.position HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps.game_id) > 10 ORDER BY avg_batting_average DESC

SELECT p.name, e.event_name, r.rank, r.total_score FROM participants p JOIN rankings r ON p.participant_id = r.participant_id JOIN events e ON r.event_id = e.event_id WHERE r.event_id = 1 ORDER BY r.rank ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT s.subject_name, c.condition_name, (SUM(e.correct) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS success_rate FROM experiments e JOIN subjects s ON e.subject_id = s.subject_id JOIN conditions c ON e.condition = c.condition_id GROUP BY e.subject_id, e.condition ORDER BY success_rate DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.company_name, p.performer_name, mf.format_name, mt.type_name, COUNT(ma.media_id) AS access_count, AVG(CAST(ma.session_duration AS REAL)) AS avg_session_duration FROM media_access ma JOIN media_records mr ON ma.media_id = mr.media_id JOIN companies c ON mr.company_id = c.company_id JOIN performers p ON mr.primary_performer_id = p.performer_id JOIN media_formats mf ON mr.format_id = mf.format_id JOIN media_types mt ON mr.media_type_id = mt.type_id GROUP BY ma.media_id HAVING COUNT(ma.media_id) > 1 ORDER BY access_count DESC, avg_session_duration DESC

SELECT j.title AS journal_title, p.name AS publisher_name, AVG(pm.metric_value) AS avg_download_value FROM journals j JOIN publishers p ON j.publisher_id = p.publisher_id JOIN impact_factors if ON j.journal_id = if.journal_id JOIN publication_metrics pm ON j.journal_id = pm.journal_id WHERE if.impact_factor_value > 2.5 AND pm.metric_name = 'downloads' AND pm.metric_value > 150 GROUP BY j.journal_id, j.title, p.name HAVING AVG(pm.metric_value) > 180 ORDER BY avg_download_value DESC;

WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        t.team_id,
        t.team_name,
        COUNT(*) AS matches_played,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_id = t.team_id THEN CAST(SUBSTR(m.score, 1, INSTR(m.score, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER)
            WHEN m.away_team_id = t.team_id THEN CAST(SUBSTR(m.score, INSTR(m.score, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS total_points,
        AVG(m.attendance) AS avg_attendance
    FROM teams t
    JOIN matches m ON t.team_id = m.home_team_id OR t.team_id = m.away_team_id
    GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        team_id,
        team_name,
        total_points,
        matches_played,
        avg_attendance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_attendance DESC) AS rank_num
    FROM team_matches
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT 
    rt.team_name,
    rt.total_points,
    rt.matches_played,
    rt.avg_attendance,
    s.sponsorship_type,
    s.sponsorship_amount
FROM ranked_teams rt
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON rt.team_id = s.team_id
ORDER BY rt.total_points DESC, rt.avg_attendance DESC, rt.team_name, s.sponsorship_type;

SELECT ms.motor_id, ms.status, ms.location, ms.motor_type, dr.fault_code_id, fc.code AS fault_code, fc.description AS fault_description, fc.severity_level, fc.category, ml.action_taken AS maintenance_actions, mpm.speed, mpm.temperature, mpm.vibration_level, pmm.model_type, pmm.model_accuracy, pmm.last_trained FROM motor_states ms LEFT JOIN diagnostic_reports dr ON ms.motor_id = dr.motor_id LEFT JOIN fault_codes fc ON dr.fault_code_id = fc.fault_code_id LEFT JOIN maintenance_logs ml ON ms.motor_id = ml.motor_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT motor_id, speed, temperature, vibration_level FROM motor_performance_metrics WHERE timestamp = (SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM motor_performance_metrics WHERE motor_id = motor_performance_metrics.motor_id)) mpm ON ms.motor_id = mpm.motor_id LEFT JOIN predictive_maintenance_models pmm ON ms.motor_id = pmm.motor_id ORDER BY ms.motor_id;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month, 'UPS' AS stock, AVG(CAST(ups AS REAL)) AS avg_adjusted_close, AVG(CAST(mkt_rf AS REAL)) AS avg_market_risk_free_rate FROM market_data WHERE ups IS NOT NULL GROUP BY month UNION ALL SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month, 'KO' AS stock, AVG(CAST(ko AS REAL)) AS avg_adjusted_close, AVG(CAST(mkt_rf AS REAL)) AS avg_market_risk_free_rate FROM market_data WHERE ko IS NOT NULL GROUP BY month ORDER BY month, stock

SELECT bsp.bsp_name, s.scenario_name, f.year, f.forecast_value, f.confidence_level, f.methodology, uc.username AS created_by, uu.username AS last_updated_by, al.username AS accessed_by, al.access_time FROM forecasts f JOIN bulk_supply_points bsp ON f.bsp_id = bsp.bsp_id JOIN scenarios s ON f.scenario_id = s.scenario_id JOIN users uc ON s.created_by = uc.user_id JOIN users uu ON f.last_updated_by = uu.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT al.user_id, u.username, al.access_time FROM access_logs al JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.user_id WHERE al.action LIKE '%forecast%' OR al.action LIKE '%scenario%' ORDER BY al.access_time) al ON al.user_id = f.last_updated_by ORDER BY bsp.bsp_name, s.scenario_name, f.year, al.access_time;

SELECT g.group_name, a.year, COUNT(a.attack_id) AS number_of_attacks FROM attacks a JOIN groups g ON a.group_id = g.group_id JOIN regions r ON a.region_id = r.region_id WHERE g.group_name IN ('ISIS', 'Al-Qaeda') AND r.region_name = 'North America' AND a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2020 GROUP BY g.group_name, a.year ORDER BY g.group_name, a.year;

SELECT sp.product_name, v.version_number, COUNT(al.access_id) AS total_accesses FROM software_products sp JOIN versions v ON sp.product_id = v.product_id JOIN access_logs al ON v.version_id = (SELECT version_id FROM changelogs WHERE version_id = v.version_id AND change_type_id IN (SELECT change_type_id FROM change_types WHERE change_type_category = 'major')) JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.user_id WHERE al.access_type = 'view' AND al.resource_accessed LIKE '%version%' AND u.role != 'QA engineer' GROUP BY sp.product_name, v.version_number ORDER BY total_accesses DESC;

SELECT v.*, b.builder_name, b.builder_address, b.builder_contact, b.builder_website, b.builder_country, b.builder_established_year, r.registration_date, r.expiry_date, oh.ownership_date FROM vessels v LEFT JOIN builders b ON v.builder_id = b.builder_id LEFT JOIN registrations r ON v.vessel_id = r.vessel_id LEFT JOIN ownership_history oh ON v.vessel_id = oh.vessel_id ORDER BY v.vessel_id;

SELECT v.variant_name, d.disease_name, COUNT(e.evidence_id) AS evidence_count, GROUP_CONCAT(dr.drug_name, ', ') AS associated_drugs FROM variants v JOIN diseases d ON v.disease_id = d.disease_id JOIN evidence e ON v.variant_id = e.variant_id JOIN drugs dr ON e.drug_id = dr.drug_id WHERE d.disease_name = 'Chronic Myeloid Leukemia' GROUP BY v.variant_id, v.variant_name, d.disease_name ORDER BY evidence_count DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.title, a.doi, a.abstract, a.publication_date, a.article_type, a.keywords, a.funding_sources, a.article_status, j.title AS journal_title, j.issn, j.e_issn, j.country, j.status AS journal_status, j.description, j.subject_area, p.name AS publisher_name, pm.metric_value AS citation_count, pm.year AS citation_year, GROUP_CONCAT(auth.first_name || ' ' || auth.last_name, ', ') AS authors FROM articles a JOIN journal_issues ji ON a.issue_id = ji.issue_id JOIN journals j ON ji.journal_id = j.journal_id JOIN publishers p ON j.publisher_id = p.publisher_id JOIN publication_metrics pm ON j.journal_id = pm.journal_id JOIN article_authors aa ON a.article_id = aa.article_id JOIN authors auth ON aa.author_id = auth.author_id WHERE p.name = 'ROUTLEDGE JOURNALS, TAYLOR & FRANCIS LTD' AND j.subject_area = 'Medicine' AND pm.metric_name = 'citations' AND pm.metric_value > 100 GROUP BY a.article_id, pm.metric_value, pm.year ORDER BY pm.metric_value DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, AVG(m.pregnant_women_registered_first_trimester) AS avg_first_trimester_registrations, SUM(m.total_pregnant_women) AS total_pregnancies FROM regions r JOIN maternal_health m ON r.region_id = m.region_id WHERE r.healthcare_facilities > 50 AND strftime('%Y', m.last_updated) = '2023' GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name HAVING AVG(m.pregnant_women_registered_first_trimester) > 1000 ORDER BY total_pregnancies DESC

SELECT o.outbreak_id, e.name AS etiology_name, o.total_cases, o.outbreak_year, l.location_name, o.start_date, o.end_date, o.status, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.factor_description) AS contributing_factors, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.intervention_type) AS interventions, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ra.agency_name) AS reporting_agencies FROM outbreaks o JOIN etiologies e ON o.etiology_id = e.etiology_id JOIN locations l ON o.location_id = l.location_id LEFT JOIN outbreak_factors ofac ON o.outbreak_id = ofac.outbreak_id LEFT JOIN factors f ON ofac.factor_id = f.factor_id LEFT JOIN interventions i ON o.outbreak_id = i.outbreak_id LEFT JOIN outbreak_reports ore ON o.outbreak_id = ore.outbreak_id LEFT JOIN reporting_agencies ra ON ore.agency_id = ra.agency_id WHERE o.outbreak_id IN (SELECT o2.outbreak_id FROM outbreaks o2 WHERE o2.etiology_id = o.etiology_id ORDER BY o2.total_cases DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY o.outbreak_id, e.name, o.total_cases, o.outbreak_year, l.location_name, o.start_date, o.end_date, o.status ORDER BY o.total_cases DESC;

SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, m.major_name, d.dept_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT dc.demographic_name) AS demographic_info, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.course_name) AS enrolled_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.course_id) AS total_courses FROM students s LEFT JOIN majors m ON s.major_id = m.major_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON m.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN student_demographics sd ON s.student_id = sd.student_id LEFT JOIN demographic_categories dc ON sd.demographic_id = dc.demographic_id LEFT JOIN course_enrollments ce ON s.student_id = ce.student_id LEFT JOIN courses c ON ce.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.student_name, m.major_name, d.dept_name ORDER BY s.student_id;

SELECT u.user_id, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS full_name, u.email, u.is_staff, u.is_superuser, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ur.role_name) AS assigned_roles, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.permission_id) AS total_permissions FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_role_assignments ura ON u.user_id = ura.user_id AND ura.removed_date IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON ura.role_id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN role_permissions rp ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, u.is_staff, u.is_superuser ORDER BY u.user_id;

SELECT u.user_name, u.email, u.role, u.department, u.status, al.access_location, COUNT(*) AS access_count, al.data_id, y.year_name, y.global_economic_conditions, y.major_events, e.entity_name, e.iso_code, e.region, e.subregion, e.gdp_per_capita, e.human_development_index, e.political_stability_index, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY u.user_id, e.entity_id, y.year_name ORDER BY u.user_name, e.entity_name, y.year_name) AS cumulative_access_count FROM users u JOIN access_logs al ON u.user_id = al.user_id JOIN entities e ON al.data_id = e.entity_id JOIN years y ON CAST(SUBSTR(al.access_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = y.year_name WHERE u.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM access_logs GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) GROUP BY u.user_id, e.entity_id, y.year_name ORDER BY u.user_name, e.entity_name, y.year_name;

SELECT w.pos AS part_of_speech, AVG(us.usage_count) AS average_usage_count FROM usage_stats us JOIN words w ON us.word_id = w.word_id JOIN historical_periods hp ON w.starting_date BETWEEN hp.start_year AND hp.end_year WHERE w.status = 'active' AND us.usage_count > 100 AND hp.period_name = 'Early English' GROUP BY w.pos HAVING AVG(us.usage_count) > 150 ORDER BY average_usage_count DESC;

WITH match_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.team_id,
        m.competition_id,
        CAST(SUBSTR(m.full_time_score, 1, INSTR(m.full_time_score, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER) AS actual_goals_scored,
        CAST(SUBSTR(m.full_time_score, INSTR(m.full_time_score, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS actual_goals_conceded,
        p.predicted_goals_scored,
        p.predicted_goals_conceded
    FROM matches m
    JOIN predictions p ON m.match_id = p.match_id
),
team_diffs AS (
    SELECT 
        mg.competition_id,
        mg.team_id,
        SUM((mg.actual_goals_scored - mg.actual_goals_conceded) - (mg.predicted_goals_scored - mg.predicted_goals_conceded)) AS goal_diff_difference
    FROM match_goals mg
    GROUP BY mg.competition_id, mg.team_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        td.competition_id,
        td.team_id,
        td.goal_diff_difference,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY td.competition_id ORDER BY td.goal_diff_difference DESC) AS rank
    FROM team_diffs td
)
SELECT 
    c.competition_name,
    t.team_name,
    rt.goal_diff_difference
FROM ranked_teams rt
JOIN competitions c ON rt.competition_id = c.competition_id
JOIN teams t ON rt.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE rt.rank <= 3

SELECT s.name, s.symbol, sm.market_cap, sm."52_week_high", sm."52_week_low", sm.ytd_change, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.portfolio_id) AS portfolio_count, n.headline, n.content, n.published_date, n.source FROM stocks s JOIN stock_metrics sm ON s.stock_id = sm.stock_id LEFT JOIN portfolio_holdings ph ON s.stock_id = ph.stock_id LEFT JOIN stock_news sn ON s.stock_id = sn.stock_id LEFT JOIN news n ON sn.news_id = n.news_id AND n.published_date = (SELECT MAX(published_date) FROM news n2 JOIN stock_news sn2 ON n2.news_id = sn2.news_id WHERE sn2.stock_id = s.stock_id) GROUP BY s.stock_id ORDER BY sm.ytd_change DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT s.name AS store_name, st.type_name AS store_type, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ps.service_name) AS pharmacy_services, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.staff_id) AS staff_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sa.sale_id) AS total_sales, SUM(CAST(sa.total_amount AS REAL)) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.supplier_id) AS supply_chain_count, SUM(sc.quantity) AS total_supply_quantity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CAST(sa.total_amount AS REAL)) DESC) AS sales_rank, CASE WHEN SUM(CAST(sa.total_amount AS REAL)) >= 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(CAST(sa.total_amount AS REAL)) >= 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS supply_chain_bucket, CASE WHEN SUM(CAST(sa.total_amount AS REAL)) >= 10000 THEN 10000 WHEN SUM(CAST(sa.total_amount AS REAL)) >= 5000 THEN 5000 ELSE 0 END AS bucket_size, AVG(CAST(sa.total_amount AS REAL)) AS average_sales_amount FROM stores s LEFT JOIN store_store_types sst ON s.store_id = sst.store_id LEFT JOIN store_types st ON sst.type_id = st.type_id LEFT JOIN store_pharmacy_services sps ON s.store_id = sps.store_id LEFT JOIN pharmacy_services ps ON sps.service_id = ps.service_id LEFT JOIN store_staff ss ON s.store_id = ss.store_id LEFT JOIN sales sa ON s.store_id = sa.store_id LEFT JOIN supply_chain sc ON s.store_id = sc.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id, s.name, st.type_name ORDER BY sales_rank ASC;

SELECT m.model_id, m.model_name, AVG(m.batch_size_gpu) AS avg_batch_size_gpu, AVG(m.batch_size_dla) AS avg_batch_size_dla, SUM(CASE WHEN mal.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_accesses, SUM(CASE WHEN mal.status = 'failure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_accesses, COUNT(DISTINCT mal.user_id) AS distinct_users, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mal2.model_id) FROM model_access_logs mal2 WHERE mal2.status = 'success' AND mal2.model_id = m.model_id) AS models_with_successful_access, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT um.user_id) FROM user_management um JOIN model_access_logs mal3 ON um.user_id = mal3.user_id WHERE mal3.model_id = m.model_id) AS models_accessed_by_user, (SELECT json_extract(mv.performance_metrics, '$.accuracy') FROM model_versions mv WHERE mv.model_id = m.model_id ORDER BY mv.version_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS avg_accuracy, (SELECT json_extract(mv.performance_metrics, '$.f1_score') FROM model_versions mv WHERE mv.model_id = m.model_id ORDER BY mv.version_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS avg_f1_score FROM models m LEFT JOIN model_access_logs mal ON m.model_id = mal.model_id GROUP BY m.model_id, m.model_name HAVING models_with_successful_access >= 1;

SELECT m.model_name, m.description, m.upload_date, m.framework, m.algorithm, m.dataset, m.hyperparameters, m.model_path, m.is_public, AVG(e.accuracy) AS avg_accuracy, AVG(e.f1_score) AS avg_f1_score, e.precision, e.recall, e.evaluation_date, e.dataset_id, e.test_size, e.train_size, e.fold_count, e.train_accuracy, e.train_f1_score, e.train_precision, e.train_recall, fm.avg_abs_odds_diff, fm.balanced_acc, fm.theil_index, fm.disparate_impact, fm.demographic_parity_diff, fm.equal_opportunity_diff, fm.group_coefficient_of_variation, u.user_name FROM models m JOIN evaluations e ON m.model_id = e.model_id JOIN fairness_metrics fm ON e.evaluation_id = fm.evaluation_id JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY m.model_id ORDER BY avg_accuracy DESC, avg_f1_score DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT c.country_name, AVG(d.gdp_per_capita) AS average_gdp_per_capita, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT l.language_name) AS official_languages, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT gf.feature_name) AS geographical_features FROM countries c JOIN demographics d ON c.country_id = d.country_id JOIN languages l ON c.country_id = l.country_id JOIN geographical_features gf ON c.country_id = gf.country_id WHERE d.gdp_per_capita > 20000 AND l.is_official = 1 GROUP BY c.country_id, c.country_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gf.feature_id) >= 1 ORDER BY c.country_name;

SELECT gl.level_id, gl.name, AVG(pp.progress) AS average_progress, AVG(pp.score) AS average_score, COUNT(DISTINCT pp.player_id) AS player_count FROM game_levels gl JOIN player_progress pp ON gl.level_id = pp.level_id WHERE gl.game_mode = 'multi-player' AND gl.difficulty_level = 'medium' GROUP BY gl.level_id, gl.name HAVING player_count > 2 ORDER BY average_score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.region_name, td.hour, td.total_output, td.density, td.average_speed, ir.incident_type, ir.incident_severity, tp.predicted_output, tp.predicted_density, tp.predicted_speed, SUM(td.total_output) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY td.hour) AS cumulative_total_output FROM traffic_data td LEFT JOIN regions r ON td.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN incident_reports ir ON td.region_id = ir.region_id AND td.hour BETWEEN CAST(strftime('%H', ir.start_time) AS INTEGER) AND CAST(strftime('%H', ir.end_time) AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN traffic_predictions tp ON td.region_id = tp.region_id AND td.hour = CAST(strftime('%H', tp.prediction_time) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY r.region_name, td.hour

WITH RECURSIVE region_paths AS (
    SELECT region_id, region_name, parent_region_id, region_name AS path
    FROM regions
    WHERE parent_region_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.region_id, r.region_name, r.parent_region_id, rp.path || ' > ' || r.region_name
    FROM regions r
    INNER JOIN region_paths rp ON r.parent_region_id = rp.region_id
)
SELECT h.holiday_name, rp.path AS region_path
FROM holidays h
INNER JOIN holiday_region_mapping hrm ON h.holiday_id = hrm.holiday_id
INNER JOIN region_paths rp ON hrm.region_id = rp.region_id
ORDER BY h.holiday_name ASC, rp.path ASC;
SELECT official_name FROM election_officials WHERE official_party_affiliation = 1 ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, ps.points_per_game, ps.player_efficiency_rating, ps.season_year FROM players p JOIN player_seasons ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id JOIN player_awards pa ON p.player_id = pa.player_id WHERE pa.award_name = 'MVP' AND ps.season_year = CAST(pa.award_year AS TEXT) ORDER BY ps.points_per_game DESC;

WITH ranked_videos AS (
    SELECT 
        c.title AS channel_title,
        v.title AS video_title,
        ve.view_count,
        ve.like_count,
        ve.comment_count,
        cc.category_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.channel_id ORDER BY ve.view_count DESC) AS view_rank
    FROM channels c
    JOIN videos v ON c.channel_id = v.channel_id
    JOIN video_engagement ve ON v.video_id = ve.video_id
    LEFT JOIN video_categories vc ON v.video_id = vc.video_id
    LEFT JOIN channel_categories cc ON vc.category_id = cc.category_id
)
SELECT 
    channel_title,
    video_title,
    view_count,
    like_count,
    comment_count,
    category_name
FROM ranked_videos
WHERE view_rank <= 3

    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
    FROM products p

),
product_order_counts AS (
    SELECT nfp.product_id, nfp.product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM north_face_products nfp
    JOIN orders o ON nfp.product_id = o.product_id
    GROUP BY nfp.product_id, nfp.product_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 2
),
cumulative_distribution AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_name, order_count,
           CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_count) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) OVER () AS cumulative_ratio
    FROM product_order_counts
),
top_half_products AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_name
    FROM cumulative_distribution
    WHERE cumulative_ratio > 0.5
),
monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT thp.product_id, thp.product_name,
           STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS order_month,
           SUM(oi.quantity) AS monthly_quantity
    FROM top_half_products thp
    JOIN orders o ON thp.product_id = o.product_id

    GROUP BY thp.product_id, thp.product_name, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_date)
),
monthly_top_sellers AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_name, order_month,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_month ORDER BY monthly_quantity DESC) AS sales_rank

)

WITH MonthlySales AS (
    SELECT 
        store_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', sale_date) AS sale_month,
        SUM(ext_price) AS total_sales
    FROM sales
    GROUP BY store_id, strftime('%Y-%m', sale_date)
),
AverageMonthlySales AS (
    SELECT 
        store_id,
        AVG(total_sales) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM MonthlySales
    GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT 
    ms.store_id,
    ms.sale_month,
    ms.total_sales,
    CASE 
        WHEN ms.total_sales >= ams.avg_monthly_sales * 1.2 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS exceeded_20_percent
FROM MonthlySales ms
JOIN AverageMonthlySales ams ON ms.store_id = ams.store_id
WHERE ms.total_sales >= ams.avg_monthly_sales * 1.2
ORDER BY ms.store_id, ms.sale_month;

WITH YearlyChanges AS (
    SELECT 
        pa1.property_id,
        pa1.assessment_year,
        pa1.assessment_value,
        (pa1.assessment_value - pa2.assessment_value) AS value_change
    FROM property_assessments pa1
    JOIN property_assessments pa2 
        ON pa1.property_id = pa2.property_id 
        AND pa1.assessment_year = pa2.assessment_year + 1
    WHERE (pa1.assessment_value - pa2.assessment_value) > 100000
)
SELECT 
    yc.property_id,
    yc.assessment_year,
    yc.assessment_value,
    yc.value_change,
    oh.ownership_date,
    o.owner_name,
    ot.owner_type_name AS owner_type,
    pt.tax_year,
    pt.tax_amount
FROM YearlyChanges yc
LEFT JOIN ownership_history oh 
    ON yc.property_id = oh.property_id
LEFT JOIN owners o 
    ON oh.owner_id = o.owner_id
LEFT JOIN owner_types ot 
    ON o.owner_type_id = ot.owner_type_id
LEFT JOIN property_taxes pt 
    ON yc.property_id = pt.property_id 
    AND yc.assessment_year = pt.tax_year
ORDER BY yc.property_id, yc.assessment_year;

SELECT e.name AS etiology_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.factor_description) AS contributing_factors, o.status AS current_status, SUM(o.total_cases) AS total_cases FROM outbreaks o JOIN etiologies e ON o.etiology_id = e.etiology_id JOIN outbreak_factors ofac ON o.outbreak_id = ofac.outbreak_id JOIN factors f ON ofac.factor_id = f.factor_id JOIN outbreak_reports ore ON o.outbreak_id = ore.outbreak_id JOIN reporting_agencies ra ON ore.agency_id = ra.agency_id WHERE ra.agency_name = 'CDC' GROUP BY e.name, o.status ORDER BY e.name, o.status;

WITH duration_seconds AS (SELECT operator_name, department_id, CAST(SUBSTR(usage_duration, 1, INSTR(usage_duration, ' ') - 1) AS INTEGER) * CASE WHEN usage_duration LIKE '%minute%' THEN 60 WHEN usage_duration LIKE '%hour%' THEN 3600 WHEN usage_duration LIKE '%day%' THEN 86400 ELSE 1 END AS duration_sec FROM instrument_usage WHERE usage_duration IS NOT NULL), ranked_departments AS (SELECT d.department_name, SUM(ds.duration_sec) AS total_duration, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ds.duration_sec) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM duration_seconds ds JOIN departments d ON ds.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name), top_departments AS (SELECT department_name FROM ranked_departments WHERE dept_rank <= 2) SELECT iu.operator_name, d.department_name, iu.usage_duration FROM instrument_usage iu JOIN departments d ON iu.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name IN (SELECT department_name FROM top_departments) AND iu.usage_duration IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(iu.usage_duration, 1, INSTR(iu.usage_duration, ' ') - 1) AS INTEGER) * CASE WHEN iu.usage_duration LIKE '%minute%' THEN 60 WHEN iu.usage_duration LIKE '%hour%' THEN 3600 WHEN iu.usage_duration LIKE '%day%' THEN 86400 ELSE 1 END DESC;

SELECT s.store_id, s.name AS store_name, f.franchise_name, o.opening_hours, o.closing_hours, o.days_open, COALESCE(SUM(sa.total_amount), 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(AVG(fb.rating), 0) AS avg_feedback_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT sa.sale_id) AS sales_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fb.feedback_id) AS feedback_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(sa.total_amount), 0) DESC) AS sales_rank, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT fb.feedback_id) DESC) AS feedback_quartile FROM stores s LEFT JOIN store_franchises sf ON s.store_id = sf.store_id LEFT JOIN franchises f ON sf.franchise_id = f.franchise_id LEFT JOIN operations o ON s.store_id = o.store_id LEFT JOIN sales sa ON s.store_id = sa.store_id LEFT JOIN feedback fb ON s.store_id = fb.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id, s.name, f.franchise_name, o.opening_hours, o.closing_hours, o.days_open ORDER BY s.store_id;

WITH product_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        p.brand_id,
        p.category_id,
        AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating,
        COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count,
        ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(r.review_id), 2) AS positive_review_percentage,
        COALESCE(i.stock_quantity, 0) AS stock_quantity
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
    LEFT JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand_id, p.category_id, i.stock_quantity
),
stock_quartiles AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        stock_quantity,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY stock_quantity) AS stock_quartile
    FROM product_stats
)
SELECT 
    ps.product_name,
    ps.avg_rating,
    ps.review_count,
    ps.positive_review_percentage,
    ps.stock_quantity,
    sq.stock_quartile,
    b.brand_name,
    c.category_name,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sq.stock_quartile ORDER BY ps.avg_rating DESC) AS rank_within_quartile
FROM product_stats ps
JOIN stock_quartiles sq ON ps.product_id = sq.product_id
JOIN brands b ON ps.brand_id = b.brand_id
JOIN categories c ON ps.category_id = c.category_id
ORDER BY sq.stock_quartile, rank_within_quartile;

WITH MonthlyTraffic AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.site_id,
        ms.site_name,
        ms.location,
        strftime('%Y-%m', td.collection_date) AS month,
        SUM(td.total_vehicle_count) AS monthly_total
    FROM monitoring_sites ms
    JOIN traffic_data td ON ms.site_id = td.site_id
    GROUP BY ms.site_id, ms.site_name, ms.location, strftime('%Y-%m', td.collection_date)
),
RankedMonths AS (
    SELECT 
        site_id,
        month,
        monthly_total,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY month) AS month_rank
    FROM MonthlyTraffic
)
SELECT 
    mt.site_name,
    mt.location,
    mt.month,
    CASE 
        WHEN rm.monthly_total = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(((rm.monthly_total - LAG(rm.monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY rm.site_id ORDER BY rm.month)) * 100.0 / LAG(rm.monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY rm.site_id ORDER BY rm.month)), 2)
    END AS percentage_change
FROM MonthlyTraffic mt
JOIN RankedMonths rm ON mt.site_id = rm.site_id AND mt.month = rm.month
WHERE rm.month_rank > 1
ORDER BY mt.site_name, mt.month;

WITH period_word_usage AS (
    SELECT 
        hp.period_id,
        hp.period_name,
        w.word_id,
        w.word_form,
        w.pos,
        SUM(us.usage_count) AS total_usage
    FROM historical_periods hp
    JOIN usage_stats us ON CAST(strftime('%Y', us.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN hp.start_year AND hp.end_year
    JOIN words w ON us.word_id = w.word_id
    WHERE w.status = 'active'
    GROUP BY hp.period_id, w.word_id
    HAVING total_usage > 0
),
ranked_words AS (
    SELECT 
        pwu.period_id,
        pwu.period_name,
        pwu.word_id,
        pwu.word_form,
        pwu.pos,
        c.category,
        pwu.total_usage,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pwu.period_id ORDER BY pwu.total_usage DESC) AS usage_rank
    FROM period_word_usage pwu
    LEFT JOIN categories c ON pwu.word_id = c.word_id AND c.status = 'active'
    LEFT JOIN parts_of_speech pos ON pwu.pos = pos.pos_name AND pos.status = 'active'
)
SELECT 
    period_name,
    word_form,
    category,
    pos,
    total_usage
FROM ranked_words
WHERE usage_rank <= 10
ORDER BY period_name, usage_rank;
