SELECT o.outbreak_id, o.etiology_id, o.total_cases, o.outbreak_year, o.location_id, o.start_date, o.end_date, o.status, e.name AS etiology_name, e.description AS etiology_description, e.common_sources, e.transmission_methods, l.location_name, l.city, l.state, l.country, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.factor_description) AS contributing_factors, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.case_id) AS case_ids, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.hospitalized) AS hospitalization_statuses, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.intervention_type) AS intervention_types, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.effectiveness) AS intervention_effectiveness, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.report_status) AS report_statuses FROM outbreaks o LEFT JOIN etiologies e ON o.etiology_id = e.etiology_id LEFT JOIN locations l ON o.location_id = l.location_id LEFT JOIN outbreak_factors ofac ON o.outbreak_id = ofac.outbreak_id LEFT JOIN factors f ON ofac.factor_id = f.factor_id LEFT JOIN cases c ON o.outbreak_id = c.outbreak_id LEFT JOIN interventions i ON o.outbreak_id = i.outbreak_id LEFT JOIN outbreak_reports r ON o.outbreak_id = r.outbreak_id GROUP BY o.outbreak_id ORDER BY o.outbreak_id ASC;

),
recent_comments AS (

WITH latest_stock_prices AS (
    SELECT 
        ticker,
        close_price
    FROM stock_data
    WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM stock_data)
),
portfolio_calculations AS (
    SELECT 
        up.user_id,
        up.ticker,
        up.number_of_shares,
        up.purchase_price,
        up.number_of_shares * up.purchase_price AS initial_value,
        up.number_of_shares * lsp.close_price AS current_value,
        (up.number_of_shares * lsp.close_price) - (up.number_of_shares * up.purchase_price) AS gain,
        ((up.number_of_shares * lsp.close_price) - (up.number_of_shares * up.purchase_price)) / (up.number_of_shares * up.purchase_price) AS portfolio_return
    FROM user_portfolios up
    JOIN latest_stock_prices lsp ON up.ticker = lsp.ticker
    WHERE up.is_active = 1
),
market_calculations AS (
    SELECT 
        date,
        market_value,
        LAG(market_value) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS previous_market_value,
        (market_value - LAG(market_value) OVER (ORDER BY date)) / LAG(market_value) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS market_return
    FROM market_data
    WHERE market_index = (SELECT market_index FROM market_data LIMIT 1)
    ORDER BY date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
user_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.user_id,
        SUM(pc.current_value) AS total_current_value,
        SUM(pc.initial_value) AS total_initial_value,
        SUM(pc.gain) AS total_gain,
        SUM(pc.gain) AS total_net_gain,
        AVG(pc.portfolio_return) AS average_portfolio_return,
        (SELECT AVG(market_return) FROM market_calculations) AS average_market_return,
        AVG(pc.portfolio_return) - (SELECT AVG(market_return) FROM market_calculations) AS alpha
    FROM portfolio_calculations pc
    GROUP BY pc.user_id
)
SELECT 
    user_id,
    total_current_value,
    total_initial_value,
    total_gain,
    total_net_gain,
    average_portfolio_return AS total_return,
    average_market_return AS market_performance,
    alpha
FROM user_summary
ORDER BY user_id;

WITH class_avg_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.class_id,
        AVG(er.score) AS avg_class_score,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.student_id) AS students_attended
    FROM exam_results er
    JOIN students s ON er.student_id = s.student_id
    GROUP BY s.class_id
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_class_score) AS overall_avg_score
    FROM class_avg_scores
)
SELECT 
    cas.class_id,
    cas.avg_class_score,
    cas.students_attended,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT en.note) AS notes
FROM class_avg_scores cas
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
LEFT JOIN exams e ON e.class_ids LIKE '%' || cas.class_id || '%'
LEFT JOIN exam_notes en ON en.exam_id = e.exam_id
WHERE cas.avg_class_score > oa.overall_avg_score
GROUP BY cas.class_id, cas.avg_class_score, cas.students_attended
ORDER BY cas.avg_class_score DESC;

WITH daily_traffic AS (
    SELECT 
        site_id,
        DATE(collection_date) AS day_date,
        strftime('%Y-%m', collection_date) AS month_year,
        SUM(total_vehicle_count) AS daily_total_vehicles,
        AVG(total_vehicle_count) AS daily_average_vehicles
    FROM traffic_data
    GROUP BY site_id, day_date, month_year
),
monthly_traffic AS (
    SELECT 
        site_id,
        month_year,
        SUM(daily_total_vehicles) AS monthly_total_vehicles,
        AVG(daily_total_vehicles) AS monthly_average_vehicles
    FROM daily_traffic
    GROUP BY site_id, month_year
),
ranked_daily AS (
    SELECT 
        dt.site_id,
        dt.day_date,
        dt.month_year,
        dt.daily_total_vehicles,
        dt.daily_average_vehicles,
        mt.monthly_total_vehicles,
        mt.monthly_average_vehicles,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dt.month_year ORDER BY dt.daily_total_vehicles DESC) AS daily_rank

)

SELECT s.stock_name, s.industry, s.sector, s.market_cap, e.exchange_name, sp_latest.open AS latest_open, sp_latest.close AS latest_close, COALESCE(AVG(sp_holiday.close - sp_holiday.open), 0) AS avg_holiday_impact, COALESCE(AVG(sp_trading.close), 0) AS avg_closing_during_trading_hours FROM stocks s JOIN exchanges e ON s.exchange_id = e.exchange_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT stock_id, MAX(date) AS latest_date FROM stock_prices GROUP BY stock_id) latest ON s.stock_id = latest.stock_id LEFT JOIN stock_prices sp_latest ON s.stock_id = sp_latest.stock_id AND sp_latest.date = latest.latest_date LEFT JOIN market_holidays mh ON e.exchange_id = mh.exchange_id LEFT JOIN stock_prices sp_holiday ON s.stock_id = sp_holiday.stock_id AND sp_holiday.date = mh.date LEFT JOIN trading_hours th ON e.exchange_id = th.exchange_id LEFT JOIN stock_prices sp_trading ON s.stock_id = sp_trading.stock_id AND sp_trading.date IN (SELECT date FROM stock_prices WHERE stock_id = s.stock_id) GROUP BY s.stock_id ORDER BY s.stock_name ASC;

SELECT p.player_name, s.season_name FROM players p JOIN seasons s ON s.start_date <= p.contract_end_date AND s.end_date >= p.contract_start_date WHERE p.salary IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(p.salary AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 10

WITH first_half_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.outlet_id,
        i.item_category_id,
        SUM(s.item_outlet_sales) AS first_half_total
    FROM sales s
    JOIN items i ON s.item_id = i.item_id
    WHERE s.sale_date >= '2023-01-01' AND s.sale_date <= '2023-06-30'
    GROUP BY s.outlet_id, i.item_category_id
),
second_half_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.outlet_id,
        i.item_category_id,
        SUM(s.item_outlet_sales) AS second_half_total
    FROM sales s
    JOIN items i ON s.item_id = i.item_id
    WHERE s.sale_date >= '2023-07-01' AND s.sale_date <= '2023-12-31'
    GROUP BY s.outlet_id, i.item_category_id
),
growth_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        fhs.outlet_id,
        fhs.item_category_id,
        fhs.first_half_total,
        shs.second_half_total,
        CASE 
            WHEN fhs.first_half_total > 0 
            THEN ((shs.second_half_total - fhs.first_half_total) / fhs.first_half_total) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS growth_percentage
    FROM first_half_sales fhs
    JOIN second_half_sales shs ON fhs.outlet_id = shs.outlet_id AND fhs.item_category_id = shs.item_category_id
)
SELECT 
    gc.outlet_id,
    ic.category_name,
    gc.growth_percentage
FROM growth_calc gc
JOIN item_categories ic ON gc.item_category_id = ic.category_id
WHERE gc.growth_percentage > 20
ORDER BY gc.growth_percentage DESC;

WITH ranked_scores AS (SELECT s.game_id, s.player_id, s.pts, p.player_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.game_id ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank FROM statistics s JOIN players p ON s.player_id = p.player_id) SELECT game_id, player_name, pts FROM ranked_scores WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY game_id, rank;

SELECT sa.agent_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.contract_id) AS total_contracts, SUM(CAST(c.total_price AS REAL)) AS sales_value, SUM(CAST(st.commission AS REAL)) AS commissions, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CAST(c.total_price AS REAL)) DESC) AS sales_rank, u.unit_name, pt.type_name AS property_type, COUNT(DISTINCT u.unit_id) AS unit_sales, SUM(CAST(c.total_price AS REAL)) AS revenues FROM sales_agents sa JOIN contracts c ON sa.agent_id = c.agent_id JOIN units u ON c.unit_id = u.unit_id JOIN property_types pt ON u.type_id = pt.type_id JOIN sales_transactions st ON c.contract_id = st.contract_id WHERE c.status = 'signed' AND c.contract_type = 'sale' AND st.transaction_type = 'sale' GROUP BY sa.agent_id, sa.agent_name, u.unit_name, pt.type_name ORDER BY sales_value DESC

SELECT AVG(pl.years_of_experience) AS average_years_experience FROM programming_languages pl INNER JOIN databases d ON pl.respondent_id = d.respondent_id WHERE pl.language = 'Haskell' AND d.database = 'Oracle 12c' AND d.proficiency_level = 'Advanced';

SELECT sp.poverty_level_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.school_id) AS number_of_schools, SUM(d.total_donations) AS total_donations_2022 FROM schools s JOIN school_poverty sp ON s.school_id = sp.school_id JOIN donations d ON s.school_id = d.school_id WHERE s.enrollment < 1000 AND d.year = 2022 GROUP BY sp.poverty_level_id

SELECT w.week_number, s.store_id, s.store_name, s.location, SUM(sd.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(CAST(sd.revenue AS REAL)) AS total_revenue, SUM(CAST(sd.cost AS REAL)) AS total_cost, AVG(CAST(sd.gross_margin AS REAL)) AS avg_gross_margin, SUM(SUM(sd.quantity)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_id ORDER BY w.week_number) AS cumulative_quantity, SUM(SUM(CAST(sd.revenue AS REAL))) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_id ORDER BY w.week_number) AS cumulative_revenue, SUM(SUM(CAST(sd.cost AS REAL))) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_id ORDER BY w.week_number) AS cumulative_cost FROM sales_data sd JOIN stores s ON sd.store_id = s.store_id JOIN weeks w ON sd.week_id = w.week_id WHERE s.location LIKE '%Los Angeles%' AND w.week_number <= 12 GROUP BY w.week_number, s.store_id, s.store_name, s.location ORDER BY s.store_id, w.week_number;

SELECT c.component_id, c.component_name, pm.sn74, pm.abt, u.username, ucp.permission_level, cv.version FROM components c LEFT JOIN performance_metrics pm ON c.component_id = pm.component_id LEFT JOIN user_component_permissions ucp ON c.component_id = ucp.component_id LEFT JOIN users u ON ucp.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN component_versions cv ON c.component_id = cv.component_id ORDER BY (pm.sn74 + pm.abt) DESC, c.component_id, u.username, cv.version;

SELECT ra.recall_id, ra.audit_date, ra.audit_type, ra.audit_result, COUNT(DISTINCT ract.action_id) AS number_of_actions, SUM(CAST(ract.action_cost AS REAL)) AS total_action_cost, MAX(ract.action_date) AS latest_action_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ri.impact_id) AS number_of_impacts, MAX(ri.impact_assessment_date) AS latest_impact_assessment_date FROM recall_audits ra LEFT JOIN recall_actions ract ON ra.recall_id = ract.recall_id LEFT JOIN recall_impact ri ON ra.recall_id = ri.recall_id LEFT JOIN manufacturers m ON ra.recall_id = m.manufacturer_id WHERE m.manufacturer_name = 'Philips Medical Systems' GROUP BY ra.recall_id, ra.audit_date, ra.audit_type, ra.audit_result ORDER BY ra.audit_date DESC

SELECT SUM(td.total_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicles FROM traffic_data td JOIN monitoring_sites ms ON td.site_id = ms.site_id WHERE ms.site_name = 'Elm St & 2nd Ave' AND td.weather_condition = 'clear' AND strftime('%Y', td.collection_date) = '2018'

SELECT u.user_name, u.user_id, e.event_id, e.year, COUNT(ua.access_id) AS access_count, MIN(ua.access_date) AS first_access_date, MAX(ua.access_date) AS last_access_date, (SELECT COUNT(ua2.access_id) FROM user_access ua2 JOIN events e2 ON ua2.event_id = e2.event_id WHERE ua2.user_id = u.user_id AND e2.event_id = e.event_id AND e2.year = e.year - 1) AS previous_year_access_count, e.date, e.holiday, e.type, e.is_recurring, ed.historical_context FROM users u JOIN user_access ua ON u.user_id = ua.user_id JOIN events e ON ua.event_id = e.event_id LEFT JOIN event_details ed ON e.event_id = ed.event_id GROUP BY u.user_id, e.event_id, e.year ORDER BY e.year DESC, u.user_name, e.event_id;

SELECT p.player_name, t.team_name, AVG(tr.rank) AS average_rank, COUNT(CASE WHEN tr.rank <= 3 THEN 1 END) AS top_3_finishes, COUNT(CASE WHEN tr.rank = 1 THEN 1 END) AS wins, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.tournament_id) AS tournaments_played, SUM(tr.comp_score) AS total_competitive_scores, SUM(tr.rounds_won) AS total_rounds_won, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN tr.rank = 1 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT tr.tournament_id) * 100, 2) AS win_rate, AVG(team_avg.avg_team_rank) AS team_average_rank, SUM(team_avg.total_team_score) AS team_total_competitive_scores, SUM(team_avg.total_team_rounds) AS team_total_rounds_won, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(tr.rank) ASC) AS overall_rank FROM players p JOIN teams t ON p.team_id = t.team_id JOIN tournament_results tr ON p.player_id = tr.player_id JOIN (SELECT p2.team_id, AVG(tr2.rank) AS avg_team_rank, SUM(tr2.comp_score) AS total_team_score, SUM(tr2.rounds_won) AS total_team_rounds FROM players p2 JOIN tournament_results tr2 ON p2.player_id = tr2.player_id GROUP BY p2.team_id) team_avg ON p.team_id = team_avg.team_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, t.team_name ORDER BY win_rate DESC, average_rank ASC

SELECT fs.source_id AS unique_identifier, fa.year_id AS fiscal_year_identifier, fa.amount AS amount_allocated_that_year, COUNT(fa.allocation_id) AS total_number_of_allocations, AVG(fa.amount) AS average_allocation_amount, tf.total_amount AS total_amount_received_across_all_fiscal_years, ABS(RANDOM()) AS random_identifier FROM funding_sources fs JOIN funding_allocations fa ON fs.source_id = fa.source_id JOIN total_funding tf ON fs.source_id = tf.source_id WHERE fs.active_status = 1 GROUP BY fs.source_id, fa.year_id HAVING tf.total_amount > AVG(fa.amount)

SELECT o.order_id, c.name AS customer_name, o.order_date, o.total_amount, o.payment_method, o.discount_amount, o.tax_amount, o.expected_delivery_date, sm.method_name AS shipping_method, sm.cost AS shipping_cost, sm.estimated_delivery_time, o.shipping_date, (o.total_amount - COALESCE(o.discount_amount, 0) + COALESCE(o.tax_amount, 0)) AS net_amount, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity, GROUP_CONCAT(i.name, ', ') AS ordered_items, o.customer_notes, o.admin_notes, c.email AS customer_email, c.address AS customer_address, c.communication_preferences, c.preferred_payment_method, c.last_purchase_date, c.total_spent, os.status_name AS order_status, CASE WHEN os.status_name = 'completed' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_completed FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN shipping_methods sm ON o.shipping_method_id = sm.shipping_id JOIN order_statuses os ON o.status = os.status_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN items i ON oi.item_id = i.item_id WHERE (o.total_amount - COALESCE(o.discount_amount, 0) + COALESCE(o.tax_amount, 0)) > 100 GROUP BY o.order_id, c.name, o.order_date, o.total_amount, o.payment_method, o.discount_amount, o.tax_amount, o.expected_delivery_date, sm.method_name, sm.cost, sm.estimated_delivery_time, o.shipping_date, o.customer_notes, o.admin_notes, c.email, c.address, c.communication_preferences, c.preferred_payment_method, c.last_purchase_date, c.total_spent, os.status_name ORDER BY net_amount DESC

SELECT 
    ii.item_id,
    ii.item_name,
    c.category_name,
    l.location_name,
    ii.quantity AS current_stock,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.action = 'Sold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_sold_units,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_pending_requests,
    ic.condition AS most_recent_condition
FROM inventory_items ii
LEFT JOIN categories c ON ii.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN locations l ON ii.location_id = l.location_id
LEFT JOIN requests r ON ii.item_id = r.item_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT item_id, condition
    FROM item_condition
    WHERE (item_id, condition_date) IN (
        SELECT item_id, MAX(condition_date)
        FROM item_condition
        GROUP BY item_id
    )
) ic ON ii.item_id = ic.item_id
WHERE ii.quantity < 10
    AND (r.action = 'Sold' OR r.status = 'Pending')
GROUP BY ii.item_id, ii.item_name, c.category_name, l.location_name, ii.quantity, ic.condition
HAVING total_sold_units > 0 OR total_pending_requests > 0
ORDER BY ii.item_id;

WITH yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', e.enrollment_date) AS year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.enrollment_id) AS enrollments,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.course_review_id) AS reviews
    FROM enrollments e
    LEFT JOIN course_reviews cr ON e.student_id = cr.student_id AND e.course_id = cr.course_id
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', e.enrollment_date)
),
yearly_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        CASE 
            WHEN enrollments > 0 THEN CAST(reviews AS REAL) / enrollments 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS ratio
    FROM yearly_counts
)
SELECT 
    year,
    ratio,
    AVG(ratio) OVER (
        ORDER BY year 
        ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS moving_avg_6yr
FROM yearly_ratio
ORDER BY year;

WITH popular_jobs AS (
    SELECT 
        jp.job_id,
        jp.job_title,
        jp.job_type,
        COUNT(a.application_id) AS total_applications
    FROM job_postings jp
    LEFT JOIN applications a ON jp.job_id = a.job_id
    GROUP BY jp.job_id, jp.job_title, jp.job_type
    HAVING COUNT(a.application_id) > 50
),
monthly_applications AS (
    SELECT 
        pj.job_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', a.application_date) AS application_month,
        COUNT(a.application_id) AS monthly_applications
    FROM popular_jobs pj
    LEFT JOIN applications a ON pj.job_id = a.job_id
    WHERE a.application_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pj.job_id, strftime('%Y-%m', a.application_date)
),
avg_applications_by_type AS (
    SELECT 
        jp.job_type,
        AVG(COUNT(a.application_id)) AS avg_total_applications
    FROM job_postings jp
    LEFT JOIN applications a ON jp.job_id = a.job_id
    GROUP BY jp.job_type
)
SELECT 
    pj.job_id,
    pj.job_title,
    pj.job_type,
    pj.total_applications,
    ma.application_month,
    ma.monthly_applications,
    aat.avg_total_applications
FROM popular_jobs pj
LEFT JOIN monthly_applications ma ON pj.job_id = ma.job_id
LEFT JOIN avg_applications_by_type aat ON pj.job_type = aat.job_type
ORDER BY pj.job_id, ma.application_month;

WITH FilteredUniversities AS (
    SELECT university_id, university_name
    FROM universities
    WHERE research_output > 0.01
),
RankedSubjects AS (
    SELECT 
        fu.university_id,
        fu.university_name,
        s.subject_id,
        s.subject_name,
        us.enrollment,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fu.university_id ORDER BY us.enrollment DESC) AS rn
    FROM FilteredUniversities fu
    JOIN university_subjects us ON fu.university_id = us.university_id
    JOIN subjects s ON us.subject_id = s.subject_id
)
SELECT university_name, subject_name, enrollment
FROM RankedSubjects
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY university_name, subject_name;

),
region_consistency AS (

)
SELECT

    s.size_name,
    rc.region_id,
    r.region_name,

SELECT e.event_name, AVG(f.rating) AS average_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT a.attendance_id) AS attendees_checked_in FROM events e LEFT JOIN event_attendee_feedback f ON e.event_id = f.event_id LEFT JOIN attendances a ON e.event_id = a.event_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', a.attendance_date) = '2023-01' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.attendance_id) > 5

SELECT 
    SUM(w.num_winners) AS total_winners,
    AVG(CAST(pt.prize_per_winner AS REAL) * (1 - CAST(c.country_tax_rate AS REAL) / 100)) AS avg_prize_per_winner_after_tax,
    SUM(CAST(pf.prize_fund_amount AS REAL) * (1 - CAST(c.country_tax_rate AS REAL) / 100)) AS total_tax_adjusted_prize_fund
FROM lottery_games lg
JOIN prize_tiers pt ON lg.game_id = pt.game_id
JOIN winners w ON pt.tier_id = w.tier_id
JOIN prize_funds pf ON pt.tier_id = pf.tier_id
JOIN countries c ON lg.country = c.country_name
WHERE lg.game_name = 'EuroJackpot'
GROUP BY lg.game_id;

SELECT e.title AS event_title, l.location_name AS location, e.curated_by AS curator, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.media_type || ': ' || m.media_url) AS media, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.source_title || ' by ' || s.author) AS sources, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u.full_name) AS contributors, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ec.category_name) AS categories, COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_id) AS unique_contributors_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ecm.category_id) AS category_count, e.verified AS verification_status FROM events e LEFT JOIN locations l ON e.location = l.location_name LEFT JOIN media m ON e.event_id = m.event_id LEFT JOIN sources s ON e.event_id = s.event_id LEFT JOIN user_contributions uc ON e.event_id = uc.event_id LEFT JOIN users u ON uc.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN event_category_mapping ecm ON e.event_id = ecm.event_id LEFT JOIN event_categories ec ON ecm.category_id = ec.category_id WHERE e.verified = 1 GROUP BY e.event_id ORDER BY unique_contributors_count DESC, category_count DESC, e.verified DESC;

SELECT t.team_name, SUM(CASE WHEN m.result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_losses, SUM(CASE WHEN m.result = 'draw' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_draws, (SUM(CASE WHEN m.result = 'win' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(m.full_time_score, 1, INSTR(m.full_time_score, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(m.full_time_score, INSTR(m.full_time_score, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN m.result = 'loss' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(m.full_time_score, 1, INSTR(m.full_time_score, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(m.full_time_score, INSTR(m.full_time_score, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN m.result = 'draw' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(m.full_time_score, 1, INSTR(m.full_time_score, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(m.full_time_score, INSTR(m.full_time_score, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END)) AS goal_difference FROM matches m JOIN teams t ON m.team_id = t.team_id JOIN competitions c ON m.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.competition_name LIKE '%Euro%' AND c.competition_name LIKE '%qualif%' GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name ORDER BY goal_difference DESC

WITH UserStats AS (
    SELECT 
        bh.user_id,
        SUM(CAST(bh.profit AS REAL)) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN bh.result = 'win' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS win_rate
    FROM betting_history bh
    GROUP BY bh.user_id
),
MostRecentBets AS (
    SELECT 
        bh.user_id,
        bh.created_at AS fixture_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bh.user_id ORDER BY bh.created_at DESC) AS rn
    FROM betting_history bh
)
SELECT 
    u.username,
    mrb.fixture_date
FROM users u
JOIN UserStats us ON u.user_id = us.user_id
JOIN MostRecentBets mrb ON u.user_id = mrb.user_id AND mrb.rn = 1
ORDER BY us.total_profit DESC, us.win_rate DESC;

WITH vote_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        legislation_id,
        legislation_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_votes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_votes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'Not Voting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_voting_votes,
        ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS vote_difference
    FROM voting_records
    WHERE strftime('%Y', vote_date) = '2022'
    GROUP BY legislation_id, legislation_name
),
legislation_2022 AS (
    SELECT 
        legislation_id,
        legislation_name
    FROM voting_records
    WHERE strftime('%Y', vote_date) = '2022'
    GROUP BY legislation_id, legislation_name
),
financing_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        v.legislation_id,
        AVG(cf.amount_supported) AS avg_amount_supported,
        AVG(cf.amount_opposed) AS avg_amount_opposed
    FROM voting_records v
    JOIN campaign_financing cf ON v.candidate_id = cf.candidate_id AND cf.year = 2022
    WHERE strftime('%Y', v.vote_date) = '2022'
    GROUP BY v.legislation_id
)
SELECT 
    vc.legislation_name,
    vc.yes_votes,
    vc.no_votes,
    vc.not_voting_votes,
    vc.vote_difference,
    fa.avg_amount_supported,
    fa.avg_amount_opposed
FROM vote_counts vc
JOIN financing_avg fa ON vc.legislation_id = fa.legislation_id
WHERE vc.vote_difference = (SELECT MAX(vote_difference) FROM vote_counts)
LIMIT 1;
